entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "LOST FILMS #09 — Orbit (1978)": a never-released Soviet sci-fi reel with practical models, fixed geography and a no-Cyrillic rule
entries.description: The creator's "Lost Films" series fakes a film that was never released, and this one is the clearest template for a period look. It is written in lower case as a production document: the format line first ("1978 soviet science fiction film … practical model effects"), then two characters "fixed for the whole film", fixed geography (the hatch with the porthole "right next to it, on its right"), eight timed static cuts, a score that "stops completely at 16s", and a style block ("shot on 35mm soviet svema color negative film, 1.66:1 frame, soft low contrast, muted colors with magenta and teal"). The constraints close it: "real-time speed, no slow motion, weightless floating only, no readable text … no cyrillic, no flags, no emblems", "the hatch stays closed from 8s to the end", and no morphing gloves. The output is a model-shot station, a tethered EVA, and a mustached colleague reading inside a porthole.
entries.prompt:
1978 soviet science fiction film, open space near an orbital station,
sequence of cuts, practical model effects.

characters, fixed for the whole film:
the cosmonaut: around thirty-five, bulky white retro spacesuit with ribbed
accordion joints, round helmet with a clear visor, life-support backpack, a
safety tether. no lettering, no flags, no emblems on the suit.
the colleague: around forty-five, bushy mustache, brown knitted turtleneck
sweater, no spacesuit.

geography, fixed for the whole film: the cosmonaut is always outside the
station, the colleague is always inside. on the side of the station module
there is one round hatch with a wheel handle, and right next to it, on its
right, one round porthole window. the hatch stays closed after the cosmonaut
goes out.

0-4s: wide static shot of a model space station slowly drifting against
black velvet space with tiny painted stars, a painted blue earth below.

4-8s: cut to medium static shot, the round hatch swings open, the cosmonaut
floats weightlessly out of it on his tether, solemn and heroic, then the
hatch closes behind him.

8-13s: cut to medium static shot, the cosmonaut tightens a bolt on a dish
antenna with a huge wrench, thin wires holding him are faintly visible.

13-16s: cut to close-up of the helmet visor, static, the earth reflected in
it, the cosmonaut nods proudly, the job is done.

16-19s: cut to medium static shot, he pulls himself along a handrail back to
the hatch and turns the wheel handle: it does not move.

19-22s: cut to close-up of his gloved hands, static, he tries the wheel again,
then knocks on the hatch with his fist.

22-26s: cut to shot through the round porthole from outside, static: inside
the cozy cabin, lit by warm tungsten lamps, the colleague floats calmly,
reading a book and sipping tea from a squeeze tube, a small cassette player
floating next to him playing music. he does not notice anything.

26-30s: cut to medium static shot outside, the cosmonaut presses his helmet to
the porthole and taps the glass with the wrench, the wrench slips from his
glove and drifts away into the stars. he slowly turns his helmet and watches
it go, completely still.

audio: 1970s soviet sci-fi score: dreamy analog synthesizer melody, slow
pulsing bass, a wordless vocoder choir, solemn and heroic, the music stops
completely at 16s. from 22s a muffled cheerful 1970s pop melody plays faintly
from the cassette player behind the glass. foley: the cosmonaut's breathing
inside the helmet, the hatch clunk, the wrench clicking, muffled knocks on
metal and glass. no dialogue.

style: shot on 35mm soviet svema color negative film, 1.66:1 frame, soft low
contrast, muted colors with magenta and teal shift, heavy grain, slight gate
weave, practical cardboard and plastic model station, stars painted on black
velvet, faintly visible support wires, chunky toggle switches and round
dials inside the cabin, cold blue backlight outside, warm tungsten light
inside.

constraints: real-time speed, no slow motion, weightless floating only, no
readable text, no letters, no cyrillic, no flags, no emblems, no logos, the
hatch stays closed from 8s to the end, preserve both faces and wardrobe across
all cuts, no morphing hands, no morphing gloves.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 rain-platform goodbye: a 30 s romance timed in one-second beats, from a closing train door to an embrace in slow motion
entries.description: A romantic-drama mood template in one paragraph: 35 mm "natural film grain, shallow depth of field and cinematic rain", a CHARACTER LOCK for both leads (stated as early 20s), "Warm amber light against cool blue rain", then the story as bracketed one-second beats ([0-1s] Hard cut: the boy slams his palm on the closing door glass … [7-8s] the emergency stop engages … [15-17s] SLOW MOTION embrace). It closes with a score that "swells at the embrace", handheld close-ups for intimacy, one overhead crane, and slow motion reserved for the embrace and kiss. The output follows the beats closely.
entries.prompt: Photorealistic Hollywood-style romantic drama short film, emotional and intimate, opens with an instant hook, shot on 35mm with natural film grain, shallow depth of field and cinematic rain. Setting: a small railway platform at night in steady rain, warm yellow platform lamps, glowing train windows, wet reflective ground. CHARACTER LOCK: the girl is in her early 20s, long dark wavy hair, cream trench coat, holding a small suitcase. The boy is in his early 20s, short dark hair, navy jacket, soaked through from rain. Both keep identical faces, clothing and hair in every shot. Warm amber light against cool blue rain, natural diegetic sound, soft piano score from the first frame. Realistic skin texture and natural expressions, no over-acting. No text overlay, no subtitles, [0-1s] Hard cut: the train doors begin to close with the girl inside, and the boy slams his palm flat against the glass. [1-2s] Extreme close-up: her eyes widen, tears welling, as she turns toward him. [2-3s] Close-up: his hand on the wet glass, rain streaming down his face, breathing hard. [3-4s] Side-tracking shot: he runs along the platform beside the slowly moving train, keeping pace with her window. [4-5s] Through the glass: she presses her hand against the window opposite his, their palms aligned. [5-6s] Close-up: his lips form a single whisper she can only half hear through the glass: “Don’t go.” [6-7s] Extreme close-up: a tear rolls down her cheek, her expression breaking. [7-8s] Wide shot: the train’s emergency stop engages and it halts with a long hiss, steam rolling across the platform. [8-9s] Low-angle shot: the carriage doors slide open, light spilling onto the wet ground. [9-10s] Close-up on her shoes hesitating at the threshold, suitcase handle tight in her hand. [10-11s] Over-the-shoulder from the boy: she stands in the doorway, rain falling between them. [11-12s] Close-up: her fingers loosen and the suitcase handle slips from her hand. [12-13s] Slow tracking shot: she steps down onto the platform, the rain soaking her hair and coat. [13-14s] Two-shot: they stand a few feet apart, neither moving, rain falling between them. [14-15s] Close-up: his eyes shining, a tentative, disbelieving smile forming. [15-17s] SLOW MOTION: she runs the last steps and throws her arms around him, droplets exploding off her coat. [17-19s] SLOW MOTION orbit shot circling them as he lifts her slightly off the ground, her face buried in his shoulder. [19-20s] Extreme close-up: her eyes closed, a trembling smile through the tears. [20-21s] Close-up: he sets her down gently and their foreheads touch, breath fogging between them. [21-23s] Profile close-up: his hand rises to cradle her cheek and brush wet hair from her face. [23-25s] SLOW MOTION: a gentle, tender kiss, rain falling in the amber lamplight around them. [25-27s] Overhead crane shot pulling up and away: the two of them holding each other on the empty platform, the train glowing behind them. [27-28s] Low-angle ground shot: her abandoned suitcase upright in a shallow puddle as the train slowly pulls away without her. [28-30s] Final wide shot: the two of them walking away together under the platform lamps, her head against his shoulder, rain softening into a drizzle. Cut to black. Natural diegetic sound throughout: rain on metal and puddles, train hiss and brake squeal, soft breathing, footsteps, her faint sob and a quiet laugh, layered with a minimal, emotional piano and strings score that builds slowly and swells at the embrace, then settles into warmth at the end. Cinematography: handheld close-ups for intimacy, smooth tracking and orbit shots for movement, one overhead crane, slow motion only on the embrace and kiss. Realistic rain physics, warm and cool color contrast.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "THE TRAIN THAT NEVER ARRIVED": a 30 s Korean mystery thriller on an empty night platform, ending on a dated ticket
entries.description: A "SUPER MASTER PROMPT" for an uncanny mood piece: a man alone on a fog-lit platform as a train that is not on the schedule stops for him. The useful parts are the timed scene blocks, which escalate the strangeness slowly (clock, empty carriage, a newspaper, the ticket reveal), and the closing REALISM RULES ("Real actors … no random transitions, no text overlays … The result must look like real footage from a high-budget Korean mystery film"). Note that the prompt asks for "vertical 16:9"; the output is 16:9 landscape.
entries.prompt:
Generate an exactly 30-second ultra-realistic Korean live-action cinematic thriller. Premium movie quality, vertical 16:9, 4K, 24 FPS, natural human expressions, realistic Korean railway architecture, physically accurate movement, atmospheric lighting, and professional sound mixing.

SCENE 1 — MYSTERIOUS ARRIVAL (0–5 SECONDS):
At 11:59 PM, a young Korean man stands alone on a deserted railway platform during heavy rain. The station announcement suddenly stops mid-sentence. A distant train headlight appears inside a dark tunnel, even though the electronic display says the last train departed hours ago.

SCENE 2 — SOMETHING IS WRONG (5–12 SECONDS):
The man steps closer to the yellow safety line. Wind rushes through the platform, moving his coat naturally. The approaching train produces a deep metallic rumble, but its headlights never seem to get closer. The station clock stops at exactly midnight.

SCENE 3 — THE IMPOSSIBLE TRAIN (12–21 SECONDS):
A vintage Korean passenger train slowly enters the station. Its windows are dark and covered with condensation. The train stops in front of him without making a sound. Through one window, he sees several passengers sitting completely still, all wearing old-fashioned clothing. One passenger suddenly turns and looks directly at him.

SCENE 4 — FINAL TWIST (21–30 SECONDS):
The doors open with a realistic pneumatic hiss. The man notices an empty seat beside a newspaper dated 30 years earlier. He looks up at the station clock, which starts moving again. The train doors suddenly close, and the train disappears into the tunnel in a single continuous shot. He looks down and finds an old ticket in his hand bearing his own name and the date of tomorrow. Cut to black.

CAMERA DIRECTION: Wide establishing shot, slow tracking shot behind the protagonist, macro close-up of the stopped clock, realistic reflections on wet concrete, natural lens behavior, and a slow final push-in on the ticket.

LIGHTING: Cold blue station lighting, warm vintage light inside the train, realistic shadows, subtle fog, wet reflective surfaces, and cinematic Korean noir color grading.

SOUND DESIGN: Heavy rain, distant rails vibrating, train brakes, electric hum, station ambience, a faint clock ticking, and a deep cinematic impact at the reveal.

REALISM RULES: Real actors, consistent wardrobe and facial features, realistic train physics, natural body movement, no cartoon effects, no excessive CGI, no distorted anatomy, no random transitions, no text overlays, no logos, and exactly 30 seconds. The result must look like real footage from a high-budget Korean mystery film.

entries.prompt:
Create a ultra-realistic cinematic short film featuring a young adult woman with long, naturally messy dark brown hair, wearing a simple light-colored sleeveless nightdress.

SCENE 1 (0–3 seconds):
A cinematic overhead shot of a young woman lying alone on an unmade bed in a dimly lit bedroom at night. Clothes are scattered across the floor, creating a realistic messy atmosphere. Teal light filters through window blinds, creating dramatic shadows across the room. She slowly sits up, looking exhausted and lost in thought.

SCENE 2 (3–6 seconds):
The camera smoothly transitions into a closer overhead angle as she gets out of bed and walks toward the bathroom. Her movements are natural, subtle and realistic. Maintain consistent character identity, facial features, hairstyle and clothing.

SCENE 3 (6–10 seconds):
Inside a small, slightly messy vintage bathroom, she stands in front of an old mirror, holding a cigarette. Soft greenish bathroom lighting contrasts with warm light coming from the bedroom. Capture intimate cinematic details, natural facial expressions and realistic reflections.

SCENE 4 (10–15 seconds):
Transition into a small vintage kitchen. She stands near the kitchen counter, holding her cigarette, looking quietly into the distance. The camera slowly pushes toward her face, capturing subtle expressions, natural skin texture and cinematic smoke movement.

VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-realistic live-action cinematography, dark moody atmosphere, teal and warm amber color grading, natural skin textures, practical lighting, realistic environmental details, shallow depth of field, cinematic camera movements, atmospheric smoke, subtle film grain, professional movie production quality.

IMPORTANT:
Maintain exactly the same woman's face, hairstyle, body proportions and outfit throughout all scenes. Natural human movements, realistic hands and fingers, physically accurate reflections, no face morphing, no character changes, no artificial animation look, no sudden transitions.

FORMAT: Vertical 16:9
DURATION: 15 seconds
QUALITY: High-detail cinematic realism.

entries.description: A 15 s fashion commercial written as a timed shot list (0–… s | SECTION). Two bare hands are in the foreground; only the right hand swipes a carousel of three floating outfits and taps to select. A palm-covered match cut reveals the model in exactly that look, followed by collar, waist/belt and hem/loafer detail cuts on match-on-action, then a full-body pullback. Each beat has its own sound cue (two directional whooshes, a selection tick, a soft footstep), music is specified at ~120 BPM, and QUALITY AND CONTINUITY counts everything ("Exactly two foreground hands … Exactly three outfits … one model", "No foreground hands after the model reveal").
entries.prompt:
Create a complete 15-second photorealistic fashion commercial in horizontal 16:9.

CONCEPT
A first-person virtual wardrobe controlled by two visible bare hands. The RIGHT hand swipes through floating outfits and selects the final look. Reveal a model wearing that exact outfit, then show several concise fashion-detail shots before a full-body finish.

Prioritise clear gesture-to-action timing, fluid transitions, clothing consistency, lively sound design, and realistic movement.

STUDIO
A seamless misty blue-grey cyclorama studio with a matte floor, soft directional lighting, and gentle contact shadows.

Keep the background, lighting, and colour grade consistent across all shots. Realistic fabric texture and natural skin detail. No furniture, clothing racks, interface graphics, or on-screen text.

FIRST-PERSON HANDS
Two bare adult hands appear naturally in the lower foreground:
LEFT hand on the lower-left side.
RIGHT hand on the lower-right side.

Show the backs of the hands with fingers pointing towards the floating outfits, as if the viewer is interacting with an invisible wardrobe interface. Both forearms extend naturally out of the bottom of the frame.

Natural skin, short clean nails, no gloves or jewellery.

The LEFT hand stays relaxed and makes only subtle supporting movements. It never triggers an outfit change.
The RIGHT hand performs exactly two right-to-left swipes, followed by one forward selection tap.

Keep the hands anatomically correct, clearly separated, and below the main clothing display. They never grab the garments or cross each other.

FLOATING WARDROBE
Each outfit floats as a coordinated invisible-mannequin ensemble with believable wearable volume. No visible mannequin, body, head, hangers, or supporting wires.

Keep the outfits at the same central position, scale, and height. Garments and accessories remain clearly separated.

LOOK 1
A cherry-red short-sleeved A-line midi dress, black low-heeled pumps, and a small structured black handbag.

LOOK 2
An ivory sleeveless knit top, charcoal-grey wide-leg trousers, and white low-profile sneakers. No handbag.

LOOK 3 — FINAL SELECTED OUTFIT
A forest-green long-sleeved blouse with a pointed collar and matte woven fabric.
High-waisted ivory tailored trousers with clean front pleats.
A narrow dark-brown leather belt with a small rectangular gold buckle.
Dark-brown leather loafers.
No jacket, jewellery, handbag, logos, or prints.

Preserve every detail of Look 3 across the floating display, model reveal, close-ups, and final shot. Never change its colour, cut, collar, belt, buckle, trouser shape, or shoes.

MODEL
One adult woman with a chin-length dark bob and natural makeup. Realistic proportions, relaxed confidence, and subtle facial expression.

She appears only after the selection, already wearing the complete final outfit. No gradual body formation or visible dressing process.

TIMELINE — EXACTLY 15 SECONDS

0.0–2.0s | FIRST-PERSON OPENING
Start immediately with Look 1 floating in the centre and both hands visible in the foreground.
The right hand performs one smooth right-to-left swipe. Look 1 slides left as a complete ensemble, directly responding to the gesture.

The left hand remains relaxed at the lower-left edge.

Use a short, directional fabric-like whoosh synchronised with the slide.
2.0–4.0s | SECOND LOOK

Look 2 slides in from the right and settles briefly at centre. Keep a clear gap between the outgoing and incoming outfits.
The right hand resets with relaxed fingers, then makes a second deliberate right-to-left swipe.
Look 2 slides out left.

The reset movement must not trigger a change.
Add a second short whoosh on the musical beat.

4.0–6.0s | SELECT THE FINAL LOOK
Look 3 enters from the right and stops at centre.

The right index finger points towards the green blouse and makes one small forward tap.
The entire outfit responds with a subtle unified forward movement, then settles.
Add a crisp, restrained selection tick with a soft low musical accent. No glowing button or visible interface.

The right hand then opens and approaches the lens, briefly filling the entire frame. The left hand drops out of view.
6.0–7.5s | MODEL REVEAL

Hide one clean match cut behind the right palm covering the lens.

As the palm clears the camera, reveal the model wearing the exact selected outfit, standing where the floating ensemble had been.

Match the clothing silhouette, screen position, colours, and studio lighting across the cut.
Both foreground hands now exit completely and never reappear.
Show a clear full-body view. The model gives a small confident smile and begins a gentle quarter-turn.

7.5–9.0s | COLLAR AND FABRIC DETAIL

Cut on the model’s turning movement to a close-up from the shoulders to the upper chest.
Show the pointed collar, clean seams, and matte texture of the forest-green blouse.

Her shoulder movement creates a small, believable fabric fold.

Use a subtle lateral camera move rather than a rapid orbit.
Add a delicate fabric rustle beneath the music.

9.0–10.5s | WAIST AND BELT DETAIL
Use a clean match-on-action cut following the same turning direction to a close-up of the waist.
Show the green blouse tucked neatly into the ivory trousers, the narrow brown belt, the rectangular gold buckle, and the trouser pleats.

The model makes a small weight shift, allowing the fabric to settle naturally.

Keep her hands outside this close-up to avoid unnecessary finger movement.
Add a quiet cloth movement and a short percussive musical accent. No exaggerated metallic buckle sound.

10.5–12.0s | TROUSER HEM AND SHOE DETAIL

Cut on the next beat to a low close-up showing the ivory trouser hems and brown loafers.
The model takes one small, controlled step onto the matte studio floor.
Show realistic trouser movement, shoe shape, and contact shadows.

Synchronise a soft leather-shoe footstep exactly with floor contact.
No slow motion or dramatic camera spin.

12.0–15.0s | FULL-BODY FINISH
Cut as the foot plants to a matching full-body three-quarter view, completing the same step.

The model settles into a relaxed fashion pose with one foot slightly forward and arms resting naturally.
She looks towards the camera with a subtle smile.
Use a slow, minimal camera pullback to show the entire outfit, including the shoes, then let the camera come to rest.

Hold the finished pose for the final second with natural breathing and slight fabric settling.
Finish on a clean musical resolution.

EDITING AND TRANSITIONS

Use different transitions only where motivated by the action:
• Smooth horizontal carousel movement during outfit selection.

• One palm-covered match cut for the model reveal.
• Clean match-on-action cuts between the model and garment details.
• A footstep match cut back to the final full-body view.
Maintain the model’s movement direction and body orientation across cuts.
No decorative spinning transitions, glitch effects, particle dissolves, random zooms, excessive motion blur, or strobing flashes.
MUSIC AND SOUND

Compose original upbeat fashion-house music at approximately 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
Use a rounded, bouncy bassline, a clean kick drum, crisp claps, light hi-hats, and a memorable short plucked-synth motif.

Keep the opening rhythm clear for the wardrobe gestures. Add a small musical lift at the model reveal, followed by distinct accents for the three detail shots. Resolve the phrase naturally at the end.
Sound effects must support the visible actions:

Two short directional whooshes for the two swipes.

One precise selection tick for the forward tap.

One soft close whoosh as the palm covers the lens.
Subtle fabric movement during the blouse and waist shots.
One gentle shoe-on-floor contact during the step.
Keep sound levels balanced and polished. No constant whooshing, loud impacts, dialogue, narration, or lyrics.
QUALITY AND CONTINUITY
Exactly two foreground hands during selection: one left and one right.

Only the right hand controls the wardrobe.

Exactly three outfits, shown in order, and one model.
No foreground hands after the model reveal.
Maintain the selected outfit exactly across every shot.
No duplicated garments, extra fingers, floating limbs, visible mannequins, intersecting accessories, fabric melting, face changes, or background shifts.
Generate the complete video with integrated editing, music, and synchronised sound effects, requiring as little additional post-production as possible.

No subtitles, logos, text overlays, end cards, or watermarks.

Soft plasticine texture, warm morning light, sound of syrup squelches, pancake thuds and a tiny happy squeak.

entries.description: A 30 s horror mood template. The look line comes first (cold fluorescent light, deep shadows, handheld, subtle grain). entries.prompt:
Create a photorealistic Korean zombie horror sequence set inside a nearly empty Seoul subway station late at night. Cinematic 4K, 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps, realistic Korean thriller cinematography, cold fluorescent lighting, deep shadows, natural skin textures, handheld camera movement, and subtle film grain.

A young Korean woman with long black hair, wearing a fitted gray cardigan, a black mini skirt, and white sneakers, stands on the subway platform checking her phone. She smiles politely at an elderly passenger before suddenly freezing mid-motion. Her smile slowly widens unnaturally, her eyes turn completely milky white, and faint dark veins emerge beneath the skin around her temples and jaw. She begins making a quiet, broken giggling sound that echoes through the empty station.

A station employee approaches to check on her. Without warning, she twists her head toward him with a sharp, unnatural movement and sprints down the platform on all fours. The employee stumbles backward as an approaching train enters the station. She suddenly stops at the edge, staring motionlessly through the train windows as passengers inside begin noticing her.

The doors open. A frightened young commuter steps out and sees her standing perfectly still in the middle of the doorway. Her expression changes instantly, and she lunges forward, forcing the commuter and two other passengers to flee into the station's narrow service corridor.

The survivors barricade themselves inside a staff room. Through a small wired-glass window, they watch her walk slowly past the door, dragging one hand along the wall. The footsteps stop. Silence. A faint scratching sound begins above them. The ceiling panels tremble as she crawls across the narrow maintenance space overhead.

One survivor quietly unlocks the emergency exit, but the door alarm suddenly sounds. The woman drops into the corridor behind them, landing awkwardly before rising with a disturbing, jerky movement. Everyone runs toward the escalators as the station lights shut off one section at a time.

FINAL SHOT: An empty subway train departs into the darkness. Through its last illuminated window, the infected woman is visible sitting alone among the empty seats, staring directly into the camera with glowing pale eyes as the train disappears underground.

STYLE: Photorealistic Korean zombie thriller, realistic acting, eerie laughter, subtle facial transformation, believable body movement, practical-looking horror effects, cold fluorescent lighting, atmospheric shadows, escalating tension, natural station ambience, train brakes, footsteps, ventilation noise, and distorted PA announcements. Use continuous spatial geography, varied camera angles, close-ups, and fast cuts during the chase.

NEGATIVE: Cartoon, anime, obvious CGI, excessive gore, exaggerated supernatural powers, inconsistent faces or clothing, teleportation, impossible body movements, subtitles, text overlays, logos, or watermarks. No background music or narration.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "real Korean TV commercial" blackout ad: an invented lamp brand, physical cause-and-effect rules, and "never like an AI demonstration"
entries.description: A realism-first commercial prompt. entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9 ultra-photorealistic premium television commercial for a fictional Korean outdoor lighting brand called LUMA.
Make it feel like a real Korean live-action TV commercial, filmed with professional cinema cameras and real actors. Natural Korean faces, realistic skin, believable human movement, authentic contemporary Korean residential environment, physically accurate lighting, realistic nighttime atmosphere, subtle film grain and premium but restrained color grading.
The commercial should feel simple, emotional, believable and cinematic, never like an AI demonstration.

Luma is a premium rechargeable outdoor lamp designed to remain illuminated during power outages.
It sits securely in a dedicated charging dock beside the home's entrance. The dock receives household electricity, while the lamp itself has no visible cable. When the power goes out, the dock simply stops receiving electricity and LUMA automatically continues operating from its built-in rechargeable battery.
The lamp never moves, disconnects, breaks or changes position.
CHARACTERS
Use exactly three fictional Korean adults:
A Korean woman in her late 20s who lives in the house.
A Korean man in his early 60s who lives farther down the street.
A Korean male delivery rider in his 20s.
Keep the same faces, hairstyles, clothing and identities throughout.
No additional identifiable characters.
STORY
0–6 SEC — NORMAL EVENING
The woman is preparing one cup of tea for herself in her kitchen.
She places the single cup on the counter.
Through the window, we see the LUMA lamp outside, securely sitting in its charging dock and providing warm light.
She picks up her tea.
Everything feels like an ordinary evening.
6–9 SEC — BLACKOUT
The electricity suddenly goes out.
The house becomes dark. Neighboring homes and streetlights also become dark.
Luma lamp remains steadily illuminated in exactly the same position, powered by its rechargeable battery.
The woman looks toward the window, surprised.
Woman: “Oh.”
She walks toward the front door.
9–16 SEC — THE OLDER NEIGHBOR
Farther down the same dark residential street, the older man is already walking home.
The blackout has made the street difficult to navigate.
He slows down, looks around and notices the warm LUMA light in the distance.
He naturally walks toward it.
The woman opens the door.
Woman: “Mr. Han? Are you okay?”
Older man: “Yeah. Suddenly I can't see a thing.”
She gestures toward the light.
Woman: “Come this way.”
He walks into the illuminated area.
Keep the interaction natural and unhurried.

AUDIO
Natural nighttime ambience, household sounds, footsteps, door movement, phone handling, package placement, tea preparation and subtle conversation.
Original understated cinematic music that gradually becomes warmer during the human moment.
All dialogue is spoken naturally in English by the Korean characters, with casual conversational delivery, realistic pauses and subtle reactions.
No narration. No subtitles. No recognizable copyrighted music.
REALISM & CONTINUITY
Keep everything physically and geographically consistent: one house, one street, one evening, three characters, one lamp and one continuous story.
Characters must physically move between locations; no sudden appearances or disappearances. Keep faces, clothing, objects and lighting consistent. The original tea remains inside until the woman deliberately retrieves it later. The luma light stays physically seated in its charging dock throughout the blackout and continues operating from its rechargeable battery.
Natural human motion and believable cause-and-effect are more important than dramatic camera effects.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "AN ORDINARY DAY IN 2003": a 30 s MiniDV home video of one woman's day, driven by a 3×3 storyboard used only as a sequence reference
entries.description: A full early-2000s camcorder template, and the first prompt in the library that uses an uploaded 3×3 storyboard grid as an ordered shot list. The key line is "The storyboard is a sequence reference. Do NOT reproduce the 3×3 grid in the output. Generate a continuous video with individual full-frame scenes, following the storyboard's order." It is repeated in the negatives ("No split screens or storyboard grids"). A MASTER IDENTITY block locks face, freckles, hair, the cream floral puff-sleeve dress and jewellery, with "Do not redesign, recast or beautify". Nine short timed scenes follow (garden, flowers, breakfast, coffee, phone call, walk, laundry, cat, sunset). CAMERA AND IMAGE QUALITY lists camcorder faults one per line (raw handheld, imperfect framing, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuation, faded colours, compression artifacts, "delayed camera reactions"). The audio is diegetic only, and the negatives ban glamour and grading ("No fashion-commercial aesthetic … No modern colour grading"). The output runs as nine full-frame scenes with an "APR 21 2003" camcorder date stamp, and no grid.
entries.prompt:
AN ORDINARY DAY IN 2003

Duration: 30 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9
Style: Authentic early-2000s MiniDV home video.

MASTER IDENTITY INSTRUCTIONS

Use the uploaded Rosie storyboard as the visual reference for the character and scenes.

Rosie must remain the exact same woman in every scene:

- Same facial identity and facial proportions.
- Same natural freckles.
- Same long, dark, wavy hair and wispy bangs.
- Same skin tone, eyes and facial features.
- Same body proportions.
- Same cream floral puff-sleeve dress.
- Same gold hoop earrings and pendant necklace.

Do not redesign, recast or beautify Rosie between scenes.

IMPORTANT: The storyboard is a sequence reference. Do NOT reproduce the 3×3 grid in the output. Generate a continuous video with individual full-frame scenes, following the storyboard's order.

SCENE-BY-SCENE DIRECTION

00:00–00:03 | The Garden

Rosie stands outside her house in the morning. She casually looks towards the camera, then turns towards the flowers. A gentle breeze moves her hair. The camera operator adjusts framing imperfectly.

00:03–00:06 | Pink Flowers

Rosie bends towards a cluster of pink flowers, gently smells them and smiles. Her hair falls naturally over her shoulder. The camera moves closer, slightly losing focus.

00:06–00:09 | Making Breakfast

Inside the modest kitchen, Rosie stirs something in a small cooking pot. She briefly looks towards the camera while continuing to cook.

00:09–00:12 | Morning Coffee

Rosie holds a floral ceramic mug with both hands, takes a sip and looks thoughtfully out of the kitchen window.

00:12–00:15 | Phone Call

Rosie sits comfortably on an old sofa, holding a cream-coloured corded landline telephone. She listens, smiles and suddenly laughs.

00:15–00:19 | Neighbourhood Walk

Rosie walks along a quiet residential sidewalk carrying her woven shoulder bag. She turns her head towards the camera while walking. The operator follows her casually.

00:19–00:22 | Hanging Laundry

In the backyard, Rosie reaches up to hang a white bedsheet on the clothesline. Wind gently moves the fabric and her hair.

00:22–00:26 | The Cat

Rosie crouches near a fluffy cream-coloured cat outside her house. She gently pets it, laughs and looks down affectionately.

00:26–00:30 | Sunset

A close handheld shot of Rosie sitting outside during sunset. The sky is pink and orange. She looks over her shoulder towards the camera, gives a small genuine smile and waves.

The recording abruptly cuts to black.

CAMERA AND IMAGE QUALITY

Authentic early-2000s consumer MiniDV camcorder footage.

- Extremely raw handheld recording.
- Organic camera shake and micro-movements.
- Imperfect framing and accidental cropping.
- Natural autofocus hunting.
- Slight exposure fluctuations.
- Occasional motion blur.
- Faded, slightly desaturated colours.
- Soft highlights and faded blacks.
- Subtle digital noise and compression artifacts.
- Natural changes in lighting throughout the day.
- Occasional delayed camera reactions.

The footage should feel like a friend casually documenting Rosie's ordinary day, not a professional film crew.

AUDIO

No soundtrack. No background music.

Only natural environmental sounds:

- Birds in the garden.
- Gentle wind and leaves.
- Kitchen utensils and cooking.
- Coffee mug touching the table.
- Telephone conversation and laughter.
- Footsteps on the sidewalk.
- Laundry moving in the breeze.
- Cat purring.
- Evening crickets.

STRICT NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS

No identity changes.
No face morphing.
No hairstyle changes.
No outfit changes.
No extra people appearing.
No artificial facial expressions.
No model posing.
No fashion-commercial aesthetic.
No cinematic glamour.
No professional camera movement.
No modern colour grading.
No artificial transitions.
No split screens or storyboard grids.
No background music.

FINAL FEELING: A precious forgotten home video from April 2003. An ordinary day, a familiar neighbourhood, and Rosie being herself.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "MOHMAYA" 15 s beauty commercial: one hue in four values, a single berry accent, macro product heroes and a payoff frame that matches the opener
entries.description: An ad-grade cosmetics spot written as a director's treatment. The palette rule does most of the work: "The whole film is one hue in four values: mauve backdrop, plum and rose knits, frosted mauve packaging … a single berry accent (blush, liner, gloss) is the only saturated colour". Lighting is fixed for the whole film (one large soft frontal source, "real skin texture and freckles kept with no smoothing", raked slightly in macros so the product reads raised and glossy). The rhythm is stated outright: "one long still opening, then a fast burst of hard cuts, easing back to stillness, then a graphic endcard". The product heroes are framed identically (hand low right, quarter-turn to the wordmark). The macros are written as physical steps (three raised dots, blended outward; the liner traces the cupid's bow, then gloss "catches a bright specular the matte liner doesn't"). The payoff duo portrait matches "the opening frame exactly" but now both models smile. The creator posted the same concept in two layouts; the stored clip is the vertical one the prompt describes.
entries.prompt:
15-second vertical beauty commercial for MOHMAYA cosmetics. Editorial, minimal, tactile. Two female models (Model A and Model B) in plum and dusty-rose knitwear against a seamless dusty-mauve studio sweep. The whole film is one hue in four values: mauve backdrop, plum and rose knits, frosted mauve packaging with brushed silver caps. Warm skin is the only warm break, and a single berry accent (blush, liner, gloss) is the only saturated colour. Lighting stays the same throughout: one large soft frontal source just above the lens, near shadowless, real skin texture and freckles kept with no smoothing. In macros it rakes slightly so the product reads as raised and glossy. Mostly locked-off camera, eye level. Rhythm: one long still opening, then a fast burst of hard cuts, easing back to stillness, then a graphic endcard.

[0–3s] Chest-up duo portrait, straight on at eye level. Model A and Model B cheek to cheek, Model A slightly forward on the left two-thirds, Model B's face overlapping at the right edge so the two heads read as one shape. Both look straight into the lens with no expression, bare-faced apart from a faint berry note on the lips. Almost no movement: Model A's chin lifts a fraction, Model B's eyes slide toward Model A without her head turning, and Model A's mouth softens slightly without smiling. A very slow push-in, about 8%, that reads as stillness. Small bone-white text "MOHMAYA" in the lower third, then "Colour, worn close.", then it fades out.

[3–4.5s] Hard cut. Product hero: a frosted mauve cream-blush tube with a silver dome cap, held upright in Model A's hand, centred against the empty mauve sweep, hand entering from the lower right. Her thumb rolls the tube a quarter turn so the MOHMAYA wordmark faces the lens, and a specular highlight travels along the barrel. Her other hand enters low with the cap off and a bead of berry cream on the fingertip. Static camera.

[4.5–6.5s] Rapid hard cuts, extreme macro on Model A's freckled cheekbone, lens level with the skin. Three raised dots of berry cream pressed onto the cheek, each casting a tiny shadow. Two fingertips blend them outward into a soft, satiny field. The fingers lift and the colour holds. Tightest shot: the soft graded edge where berry meets bare skin, freckles showing through.

[6.5–8s] Hard cut. Model A in three-quarter close-up, finished cheek to the lens, eyes down. Cut wider to a medium shot: Model B leans in from the right and turns her cheek to the light, comparing. Both carry the same berry flush. Model A's hand enters frame right holding a lip pencil.

[8–9s] Hard cut. Second product hero, framed exactly like the blush shot: a mauve MOHMAYA lip liner with a deep berry tip, held upright, hand low right, empty sweep behind. It rotates to show the wordmark, and a matching gloss tube rises into frame beside it.

[9–11.5s] Hard cuts, extreme macro on the mouth, framed horizontally. The pencil traces the cupid's bow, then slowly closes the line along the lower lip and lifts away, leaving a clean berry outline. A gloss wand lays wet berry into the centre of the lower lip, and the gloss catches a bright specular the matte liner doesn't. The lips press together once and part, and the gloss evens out. Deepest, richest colour of the film.

[11.5–13s] Hard cut. Model B in a clean frontal close-up, finished cheek and lips, eyes to the lens, the first fully finished portrait. A very slow push-in that completes and holds.

[13–14s] Hard cut. Payoff duo portrait matching the opening frame exactly (same placement, distance, lens and light), but now both models are made up and both smile for the first time. Model B lets out one brief, natural laugh.

[14–15s] Hard cut to a flat graphic endcard with zero colour: horizontal black and white bands edge to edge, "MOHMAYA" in widely spaced small caps across the centre band, and a smaller "SHOP NOW" band directly beneath. Static hold to the end.

Avoid: beauty-filter skin smoothing, extra people, handheld shake, lens flares, colour outside the mauve/plum/berry palette, warped or misspelled text, changes to product shape between shots.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "THE MIDNIGHT FASHION EDIT": a 15 s seamless-loop reel where a final barrel roll into a dark foreground object rejoins the opening rise
entries.description: A loop-seam recipe written as its own block before the scenes. SEAMLESS OPENING & LOOP DESIGN opens on an extreme low angle behind a velvet chaise with "A dark, out-of-focus foreground object partially cover[ing] the lens", and the camera starts rising at once. The ENDING FRAME rushes, in a clockwise barrel roll, "toward the exact same dark foreground object" until the frame is fully dark. It then lists what must match across the seam (camera position and height, lens angle, foreground placement, darkness/exposure/colour, motion direction and speed, background light) and bans the usual cheats ("No fade-to-black followed by a separate restart. No sudden camera reset. No visible jump cut."). Between the seams, five 3 s outfit scenes in one penthouse set give it wardrobe value too. The output opens and closes on the same dark occluded frame, so it replays without a visible cut.
entries.prompt:
THE MIDNIGHT FASHION EDIT

15-second seamless looping fashion reel | Vertical 9:16 | 24 FPS | 5 scenes × 3 seconds

SEAMLESS OPENING & LOOP DESIGN

CRITICAL: The opening and ending must be visually identical and designed as one continuous camera movement.

OPENING FRAME (0.0s)

Begin with an extreme low-angle shot from behind the emerald-green velvet chaise lounge. A dark, out-of-focus foreground object partially covers the lens. Only a small portion of the golden lamp and warm penthouse lighting is visible.

The camera begins moving upward immediately, revealing the room as it rises toward the overhead composition.

ENDING FRAME (14.5–15.0s)

During the final clockwise barrel roll, rush toward the exact same dark foreground object used in the opening shot.

The foreground object gradually covers the entire lens until the final frame becomes completely dark.

Match the final frame to the opening frame in:

Camera position and height.
Lens angle and perspective.
Foreground object placement.
Darkness, exposure, and color.
Motion direction and speed.
Background lighting and visual composition.

LOOP CONNECTION

At exactly 15.0 seconds, the camera must continue the same upward movement established at 0.0 seconds. The opening rise should feel like the natural continuation of the final transition.

No fade-to-black followed by a separate restart. No sudden camera reset. No visible jump cut. No change in lighting.

The first and last frames must match precisely, and the motion across the cut must feel continuous.

FIVE FASHION SCENES

0–3s — THE CLASSIC MUSE

A timeless luxury outfit. She lies diagonally across the emerald velvet chaise, holding a perfume bottle above her face, then gently turns toward the camera.

3–6s — THE STREET-STYLE ICON

A completely different modern fashion look. One arm behind her head, the other near her waist. She adjusts her sleeve with a relaxed, confident expression.

6–9s — THE SOFT LUXURY LOOK

A romantic, elegant fashion look. She gently brushes her hair back and looks toward the overhead camera with a subtle smile.

9–12s — THE NIGHT OUT EDIT

A bold evening look. She holds an open fashion magazine above her chest, turns one page, and lowers it slightly.

12–15s — THE FINAL STATEMENT

A striking statement-fashion look. She rests one hand near her face, crosses her ankles, and gives the camera a subtle confident smile. The camera then performs the final clockwise barrel roll toward the dark foreground object.

ENVIRONMENT & CINEMATOGRAPHY

Maintain the same luxurious Parisian penthouse throughout: emerald-green velvet chaise, marble flooring, glowing city skyline, golden sculptural lamps, flowers, fashion magazines, vintage mirror, and candlelight.

Warm cinematic lighting, realistic fabric movement, subtle film grain, rich shadows, premium editorial color grading.

AUDIO

130 BPM laid-back luxury deep-house groove.
Consistent rhythm across all 15 seconds.
Bass impact and airy whoosh on each transition.
Natural fabric rustles and scene-specific foley.
No dialogue, no vocals.

FINAL TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Duration: exactly 15 seconds.
Frame rate: 24 FPS.
Aspect ratio: 9:16.
Five scenes, exactly 3 seconds each.
Continuous visual environment.
Smooth camera movement.
No black-frame pause at the loop point.
No captions, logos, or watermarks.
Photorealistic live-action quality.

MOST IMPORTANT: Design the reel as a continuous circular camera journey. The final camera movement must return to the precise opening composition so viewers cannot tell where the video ends and begins. The loop must feel natural even when replayed repeatedly.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "LOST FILMS #12 — The Ladder (1925)": a never-released silent comedy with fixed-character rules, iris transitions and heavy orthochromatic grain
entries.description: A craft-forward Seedance 2.5 "lost film" template. Characters are locked for the whole reel (a twenty-five-year-old skinny man with checkered flat cap, striped jersey and suspenders; one fluffy white kitten), and geography is fixed (the long ladder stays on his right shoulder until it leans on the tree). Nine timed static cuts run the slapstick (street, ducking gentleman, carriage under the ladder, snipped ostrich feather, park, climb, kitten walks down the other side, deadpan close-up, dangling iris-out). Style is shot as 35mm orthochromatic B&W 1.33:1 with soft grey tones, heavy grain, scratches, dust, flicker, vignette and hand-cranked motion; audio is solo out-of-tune upright piano plus one meow. Constraints ban colour, slow motion, intertitles, readable text, logos, children and morphing hands. The iris-in/iris-out bookends make it a grain + transition reference.
entries.prompt:
1925 silent film comedy, black and white, a busy city street and a park,
sequence of cuts.

characters, fixed for the whole film:
the young man: around twenty-five, tall and skinny, clean-shaven, big ears,
checkered flat cap, striped jersey, suspenders, baggy trousers. no mustache,
no cane, no bowler hat.
the kitten: a small fluffy white kitten.

geography: the young man always carries one very long wooden ladder
horizontally on his right shoulder, until he puts it against the tree.

0-3s: iris opens on a wide static shot of a busy 1920s city street, the young
man walks in from the left carrying the long ladder on his shoulder.

3-7s: cut to wide static shot, he turns around and the back of the ladder
swings behind him, a gentleman in a top hat ducks just in time, his top hat
flies off.

7-10s: cut to wide static shot, a horse-drawn carriage passes, the young man
lifts the ladder high above his head and the carriage drives right under it.

10-14s: cut to wide static shot, a lady in a hat with a huge ostrich feather
walks by, the ladder sweeps over her and snips off the feather. he bows to
apologize, turns, and the ladder swings just over the heads of two painters
in white overalls, who duck.

14-17s: cut to wide static shot of a park, a fluffy white kitten sits on a
tree branch meowing, the young man leans the ladder against the trunk.

17-21s: cut to medium static shot, he climbs up heroically and reaches for the
branch, the kitten calmly walks down the trunk on the other side and strolls
away.

21-24s: cut to close-up of the young man's face, static, completely deadpan,
he slowly looks down.

24-27s: cut to medium static shot, the ladder slides sideways and falls to the
ground, he grabs the branch and hangs from it with both hands.

27-30s: cut to wide static shot, the young man dangles from the branch, the
kitten sits on the grass below and looks up at him. the iris slowly closes.

audio: a solo out-of-tune upright piano accompaniment in 1920s ragtime style,
bouncy and quick, tremolo chords at moments of danger, a descending comic
run when the ladder falls, a soft meow. no dialogue, no sound effects except
the piano and the meow.

style: shot on 35mm orthochromatic black and white film, 1.33:1 frame, soft
grey tones, bright white sky, heavy grain, scratches, dust specks, flicker,
dark vignette edges, iris-in and iris-out transitions, slightly fast jerky
hand-cranked motion typical of 1920s films, static wide camera.

constraints: black and white only, no color, no slow motion, no intertitles,
no readable text, no signs with letters, no logos, nobody is hurt, no
children, only one kitten, the ladder stays the same length, preserve the
young man's face and wardrobe across all cuts, no morphing hands.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "A SUMMER TO REMEMBER, 1997": a 30 s Sony MiniDV home video of a Japanese mountain-village summer with authentic camcorder faults
entries.description: A thin-category grain fill written as a MiniDV cassette memory. FORMAT locks 30 s / 16:9 / 24 fps / photorealistic live-action and "Authentic 1997 Sony MiniDV home-video aesthetic." Two adult characters (a young Japanese woman in lavender blouse and sage pinafore; an elderly grandmother) move through timed rural scenes — doorway, hydrangeas, pottery wheel, orchard table, kitchen, stream, engawa sparklers, dusk wide. The camcorder-fault language (soft MiniDV compression, warm faded colours, handheld shake, exposure hunting) is the point for the grain shelf. Audio stays diegetic; negatives keep it from drifting into a fashion commercial.
entries.prompt:
FORMAT: Exactly 30 seconds | 16:9 | 24fps | Photorealistic live-action | Authentic 1997 Sony MiniDV home-video aesthetic.

CHARACTERS:

Young Woman: A cheerful young Japanese woman with warm brown eyes and long black hair in a loose low side braid with a cream ribbon. She wears a lavender cotton blouse, sage-green pinafore dress with wooden buttons and pockets, cream belt, off-white socks, brown Mary Jane shoes, pearl earrings and a woven bracelet. Preserve her face, hairstyle, proportions and complete outfit consistently.

Grandmother: Elderly Japanese woman with short silver-grey hair and gentle wrinkles, wearing a dusty-rose floral house dress, beige linen apron and dark slippers. Keep her appearance consistent.

LOCATION: A peaceful Japanese mountain village in summer 1997. A weathered wooden cottage beside a flowing river, wooden veranda, terraced green hills, plum orchard, hydrangeas, bamboo fencing, wooden footbridge and a tiny traditional pottery workshop.

30-SECOND SCENE SEQUENCE:

00–04s: The young woman opens a wooden sliding window, lets morning sunlight enter and steps onto the veranda, smiling at the mountains.

04–08s: She joins her grandmother in the flower garden, cuts hydrangeas and laughs as a butterfly flies near her face.

08–12s: Inside an old pottery workshop, grandmother teaches her to shape wet clay on a pottery wheel. They laugh at her uneven ceramic bowl.

12–16s: In the plum orchard, she collects ripe plums and peaches, washes fresh fruit and arranges homemade sweets.

16–20s: Both prepare a traditional summer meal in the wooden kitchen, cooking vegetable tempura and chilled noodles. She accidentally drops cucumber and laughs.

20–23s: She walks to the river, removes her sandals and playfully splashes shallow water toward the camera.

23–27s: At sunset, they hang paper lanterns beneath the veranda, light them and share green tea while enjoying the warm evening.

27–30s: She rests her head on grandmother's shoulder. A distant handheld shot captures the glowing cottage, flowing river and mountain silhouettes before the footage abruptly cuts to black.

CAMERA STYLE: Genuine 1997 Sony MiniDV family footage. Imperfect handheld movements, natural micro-shakes, crooked framing, autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, slight digital noise, compression artifacts, interlacing, motion blur and faded warm colors. No modern cinematic grading or professional stabilization. All actions spontaneous and naturally captured.

AUDIO: Only natural ambience: birds, breeze, wooden doors, garden sounds, pottery wheel, river splashes, sizzling food, ceramic dishes, lanterns, evening insects and distant village sounds. No music or narration.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No modern buildings, vehicles, smartphones, contemporary fashion, anime, fantasy, cinematic effects, slow motion, posing, identity changes, outfit changes, duplicated characters, extra limbs, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

FINAL REQUIREMENT: Exactly 30 seconds. Preserve both characters' faces, hairstyles and clothing throughout. Natural transitions, realistic human behavior and authentic nostalgic family-video atmosphere. A precious Japanese summer memory recorded on an old MiniDV cassette.

entries.prompt:
Ultra-realistic live-action Korean revenge-comedy along Seoul’s Han River at golden hour. Handheld cinematic camera, warm sunset, authentic park ambience, realistic physics, fast-paced slapstick action, expressive reactions.

**Characters:** Lee Ji-won Korean woman in her 20s, high ponytail, mint-green windbreaker, black cycling shorts, sneakers, riding a city bicycle. Shin Tae-oh — Korean man in his 20s, black cap, grey hoodie, riding an electric scooter. Korean grandmother wearing a purple visor.

**30-SECOND ACTION:**
0–3s: Grandmother sits on a bench with her brown handbag. Tae-oh snatches it and speeds away on his scooter.
3–6s: She cries out. Ji-won hears her, shouts “저기요!”, and starts chasing on her bicycle.
6–12s: Tae-oh weaves through joggers, laughing. Ji-won catches up, follows him across grass, and launches off a small ramp, landing with a hard bounce.
12–18s: Tae-oh scatters a family's picnic snacks. Ji-won hops over the blanket, shouting “거기 서!”, then grabs the handbag strap beside his scooter. A brief, chaotic tug-of-war makes the scooter wobble.
18–25s: Ji-won yanks the bag free. Tae-oh loses control, spins off the path, flies over the handlebars, and crashes into a large circular fountain with a huge splash. Pigeons scatter.
25–30s: Ji-won returns the bag to the grandmother and asks, “다 괜찮으세요, 할머니?” The grandmother smiles and pats her hand. Behind them, the drenched Tae-oh sits in the fountain beside his floating cap as amused joggers and families clap and film.

**Audio:** Natural Korean-only dialogue, perfectly lip-synced, wind, bicycle chains, scooter motor, footsteps, startled gasps, water splash, pigeons, traffic, and applause.

**Requirements:** Consistent character identities, faces, outfits, and location throughout. Clearly show the theft, ramp jump, picnic leap, tug-of-war, scooter spin-out, and fountain crash. Believable momentum and water physics. Photorealistic skin, natural movement, non-gory slapstick. No logos, brands, subtitles, text overlays, cartoon effects, or watermark.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 phone-drop match cut: a desert selfie falls into a snowy alpine village pickup
entries.description: An object-driven environment transition. 0–3 s is a Moroccan desert golden-hour selfie (terracotta outfit, hot-air balloons); the phone then falls in POV; a black beat bridges; a gloved hand picks the same phone up on snowy cobblestones; the woman is now in a white coat and burgundy scarf in a Christmas alpine village at blue hour with a horse-drawn carriage. The phone is the continuity anchor across wardrobe and climate. Specs call for natural smartphone shake, realistic skin and no text/logos.
entries.prompt:
0–3 seconds — Moroccan Desert: She films herself walking through breathtaking golden sand dunes at sunset, wearing a flowing terracotta outfit with a lightweight scarf fluttering in the breeze. The warm orange sky, distant hot-air balloons, and endless dunes create a spectacular backdrop. Her long hair moves naturally in the wind as she smiles charmingly into the camera. Realistic handheld selfie footage with gentle walking movements.
3–5 seconds — Phone Drop Transition: While turning to show the scenery, her phone suddenly slips from her hand and tumbles toward the sand. The footage shakes naturally, briefly capturing her hand reaching for it before the lens becomes completely dark as the phone lands. Realistic motion blur, muffled impact, and natural camera movement.
5–7 seconds — Hidden Transformation: During complete darkness, execute a perfectly concealed match cut. The phone is now lying on a cobblestone street in a stunning snow-covered European village. The same woman picks it up, now wearing an elegant ivory winter coat, burgundy knitted scarf, and stylish winter boots. Snowflakes drift past the lens as the camera rises naturally.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "Some heroes never stop walking": a composed woman fixes strangers' small mishaps with one folded newspaper, never breaking stride
entries.description: A four-shot NYC sidewalk micro-story built on a strong CHARACTER LOCK (same face, wardrobe, and the same folded broadsheet in every shot; never stops, never looks at camera) and an AUDIO RULE of natural foley only. Each shot gets Camera / Action / Sound lines and HARD CUT separators: low locked-off café table fix, handheld backing MCU cup-lid save, side-on tracking pigeon scare, slow wide walk-away. A clean template for prop-as-continuity-anchor performance and silent storytelling.
entries.prompt:
AUDIO RULE: Natural sound only. No music, no score, no voiceover, no dialogue. Ambient New York city sound and foley only.

CHARACTER LOCK: <<<image_1>>> , exactly as shown in the character sheet in every shot: same face, hair, build, wardrobe, posture and proportions. She carries one folded broadsheet newspaper, the same one in every shot. She never stops, never breaks stride, never looks at the camera, and keeps an unhurried, composed expression. Location: <<<image_2>>> , late-autumn daylight, consistent weather and color grade across all shots.

SHOT 1 (0:00–0:03)
Camera: Low, locked-off medium shot at table height on a busy sidewalk. Slight tracking left to right as she enters frame.
Action: <<<image_1>>>  walks past a sidewalk café where a diner's wobbling table sloshes his coffee. Without slowing, she flicks the folded newspaper low and slides it under the short table leg. The table settles and the coffee goes still. The diner looks down, then up, confused and pleased. She is already out of frame.
Sound: Footsteps on pavement, the rattle of a wobbling table, the cup settling, traffic hum, distant chatter.

HARD CUT

SHOT 2 (0:03–0:06)
Camera: Handheld tracking shot from the front, medium close-up, backing away as she walks toward us.
Action: A tourist juggling bags knocks his takeaway cup off the rim of a trash bin. As it falls, <<<image_1>>> , still mid-stride, taps the newspaper out in one fluid motion and bats the lid back onto the cup. He catches it and stares at her back as she passes.
Sound: Quick cup tumble, the soft slap of paper on plastic, her steady footsteps, a surprised breath from the man.

HARD CUT

SHOT 3 (0:06–0:09)
Camera: Wide side-on profile tracking shot, matching her pace, with a crosswalk and yellow taxis behind her.
Action: A man on a bench is lost in his phone while a pigeon edges toward his sandwich. Without turning her head, <<<image_1>>>  snaps the newspaper once as she passes. The pigeon flaps off and the sandwich is saved. The man looks up, bewildered, with no idea who helped.
Sound: A sharp crack of newsprint, wing flutter, honking taxis, a street vendor's cart rattling.

HARD CUT

SHOT 4 (0:09–0:12)
Camera: Slow wide shot from behind, centered on her small figure as she walks away down the long avenue.
Action: <<<image_1>>>  tucks the newspaper under her arm and keeps walking at the same unhurried pace. Behind her, the people she helped each carry on with their day, lighter and smiling. She never looks back and disappears into the crowd and morning light.
Sound: Footsteps fading into the city ambience, distant traffic, a faint laugh, the soft rustle of newsprint under her arm.

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 reference-mode UGC workflow: a 7-section meta-prompt that turns a first frame, a real TikTok performance and a product shot into an un-AI-looking ad
entries.description: Methodology entry. The creator's workflow: real TikTok clip as performance/voice reference (@Video1), an older-phone-looking first frame (@Image1), a product image (@Image2), then this template given to an LLM to write the Seedance 2.5 reference-mode prompt in lowercase plain English with 7 numbered sections (format & references, body language from the video, bracketed exact dialogue, line-by-line emotional reactions, …, room-matched audio, one continuous shot with a NOT list: no music, cuts, zooms, captions). Rules ban generic words like "cinematic". 720p suggested; Wan 3.0 noted as a cheaper alternative.
entries.prompt:
You are an expert at writing prompts for Seedance 2.5 (reference mode) that produce realistic, TikTok-style UGC videos. Nothing about the result should look or sound like AI.

I'm uploading:
- @Image1 – the exact first frame of the video (the person, outfit, setting, lighting and framing)
- @Video1 – a real TikTok video. Copy the person's physical performance, energy, movement and way of talking from it
- @Image2 – the product

Study all three files carefully. Then write one prompt in plain English, lowercase, with these 7 numbered sections and nothing else:

1. format & visual references
The length of the video, "natural tiktok ugc style", @Image1 as the exact first frame and visual reference for the person, outfit, setting, lighting and framing, @Video1 as the reference for physical performance, voice and accent.

2. body language & movement
Match the posture, hand gestures, facial movements and body language from @Video1. Describe 1–2 specific movements you can actually see in @Video1 (for example, how she sits down, leans in or moves her hands while she talks).

3. dialogue
"she says exactly what is written between the brackets: [ ... ]". Write the script in the brackets. It should sound like a real person talking to a friend, not like an ad: short sentences, small reactions, no marketing words. It must fit the video length when spoken at a natural pace.

4. voice, emotions & reactions
How she speaks (pace, energy, tone) and how her emotions change line by line. Quote specific lines from the script and describe the reaction on each one (a quick laugh, disbelief, getting excited, turning mock-serious, ending warmly). Ask for natural changes in pitch, emphasis and speed, with tiny pauses that fit the reactions.

5. product interaction
Exactly when and how @Image2 comes into the video (where she takes it from, on which line it appears), how she shows it to the camera with the label visible, and what her other hand does at the same time.

6. timing & realism
Fit the full performance within the video length. Realistic skin texture, natural blinking, accurate lip sync and room sound that fits the setting (echo in a bathroom, quiet hum in a bedroom, wind and traffic outside).

7. camera & restrictions
One continuous shot, the same camera as in @Image1 (handheld or stationary), and a list of what the video must NOT have: no shouting, no music, no cuts, no zooms, no captions, no tiktok logo, no extra spoken words.

Rules:
- Use @Image1, @Video1 and @Image2 exactly like that, so Seedance knows which file is which.
- Describe only what you can see in the files. Don't invent a new room, outfit or person.
- Keep every section short and concrete. No general phrases like "high quality" or "cinematic".
- Give me only the finished prompt, ready to paste.

MY VIDEO
- Product: [product name + what it does]
- Video length: [e.g. 15–20 seconds]
- Accent: [e.g. american]
- What she should say / the idea: [e.g. she just spent the last of her money on this cream and she's excited but feels a bit guilty]

entries.title: Seedance 2.5 "snack mission": a tactical squad shops a Korean convenience store in a handheld military-game cutscene look
entries.description: A 30 s comedic POV with three reference-locked roles (@image1 talkative lead, @image2 gruff veteran, @image3 faceless operators), a timestamped shot list of whip-pans, selfie push-ins and aisle tracking, and a STYLE AND CAMERA block mixing wide-angle slight fisheye, saturated fluorescents vs cold night exterior, game-engine realism with film grain and in-game subtitle format. Good reference for genre-mash realism and multi-reference casting.
entries.prompt:
A 30-second, photorealistic, handheld, wide-angle video in a cinematic modern-military-game look. Setting: a brightly lit Korean convenience store, with Korean signage and snack aisles. At the end the scene moves to the store's red-and-white entrance at night. Soldiers in full tactical gear are casually "shopping" in the store while civilians react in confusion. The tone is comedic and absurd, mixing war-game realism with an everyday grocery run.

CHARACTERS
- @image1 is the MAIN CHARACTER, a young man with dark hair. He wears a black tactical hooded jacket, a tan plate carrier with magazine pouches and a shoulder radio with antenna, tan gloves, camo pants, a rifle slung on his back and a helmet clipped to his hip. He is expressive, friendly and talkative, and often looks straight into the camera.
- @image2 is the veteran squad leader: boonie hat, full moustache and beard, headset mic, shemagh scarf, dark blue shirt with rolled sleeves, olive plate carrier and olive cargo pants. He is calm and gruff.
- @image3 is the generic tactical squad: faceless operators in black balaclavas and helmets with night-vision goggles, comms headsets and dark navy uniforms with black plate carriers. Several of them move through the store in the background.

SHOT LIST
0:00–0:02. Handheld, over-the-shoulder view from behind a helmeted @image3 soldier in the foreground, whose back fills the left of the frame. Panicked civilians, including a red-haired woman, scatter in the aisle. Someone points toward the back of the store. @image1 stands on the right, looking left at the commotion with a tense, alert expression.
0:02–0:06. @image1 turns and addresses the camera directly, saying something urgent, with wide eyes and raised eyebrows. The camera pushes in to a tight, selfie-style close-up of his face. His radio antenna is visible on his chest rig. Soldiers and shoppers blur past behind him.
0:06–0:08. The camera whips around and down a long snack aisle packed with chips, instant noodles and drinks. Armed @image3 operators move through it, and one raises a fist in a halt signal.
0:08–0:12. Wide shot down the aisle toward the refrigerated drinks wall. @image2 walks toward the camera with a loose, slightly goofy gait, rifle on his back. Then the view swings back to a sliding shot along the shelves.
0:12–0:14. Medium shot of @image1 smiling at the camera and pointing at products on the shelf, rifle visible over his shoulder.
0:14–0:18. @image2 and @image1 meet in the aisle. @image2 hands him an item, and @image1 takes it. Shots cut between them, with @image2 putting snacks into a purple shopping basket.
0:18–0:22. A shelf aisle with household goods and Korean labels. @image1 talks to the camera, then reaches out to a red-edged shelf to pick up a product. He is seen from the side and then from behind with his backpack and rifle. He then walks toward the camera in camo pants, helmet swinging at his hip.
0:22–0:26. Near the store entrance at night, with red-and-white branding and Korean text on the windows. @image1 carries a bulging green reusable shopping bag that says "OPEN". He looks back over his shoulder with a big grin. An @image3 operator stands behind him in the doorway. Game-style subtitles appear at the bottom.
0:26–0:28. Behind-the-shoulder shot as @image1 hands the green bag to the @image3 operator at the door. An @image2/@image3 arm enters the frame on the right. The subtitles read roughly "Pick it up, Chow, we're leaving." and "Roger that, Sergeant."
0:28–0:30. First-person POV of a gloved hand holding a smartphone over a payment terminal at the checkout counter. The cashier, in a blue uniform, flinches with arms raised in front of the face. Camo-clad legs and boots of squad members stand at the right edge. A subtitle reads roughly "Private Jo Karen."

STYLE AND CAMERA
- Handheld, shaky, first-person and over-the-shoulder camera with fast whip pans and push-ins. Wide-angle lens with slight fisheye distortion.
- Bright, saturated fluorescent store lighting in the aisles, contrasted with a cold dark night exterior at the entrance.
- High-detail, game-engine-realistic character rendering with film grain, in a 3D game cutscene look.
- Bottom-of-screen in-game dialogue subtitles in a small sans-serif font ("Name: line" format).

AUDIO
- Ambient store sounds: fluorescent hum, shuffling boots, rustling gear, beeping of the checkout terminal.
- Muffled radio chatter. @image1 speaks casually and urgently, and @image2 answers in a gruff, low-voiced military tone.
- Background music tension that turns comedic as the shopping run continues.

ASPECT RATIO: 1208:720 (about 16:9 landscape), 30 seconds.

entries.title: Gemini Omni four-part style progression on a reference video: crayon → graphite line-boil → translucent glass → risograph print
entries.description: An official video-to-video style-transition recipe. The astronaut's motion comes from an input video; the prompt only names four looks in order and one connective verb for each change ("Transition seamlessly into…", "Next, morph into…", "Conclude the sequence with…"). Each look carries its own texture vocabulary: waxy crayon on granulated paper; graphite cross-hatching with a 12fps "line boiling" effect; refractive 3D glass with caustics in a minimalist studio; three-colour risograph with halftone grain and registration overlays. Useful as a pattern for style-morph transitions where motion stays fixed and only the medium changes.
entries.prompt: Create a four-part stylistic progression of the video reference that begins with a vibrant colored crayon aesthetic, featuring rich, waxy, textured strokes and playful, hand-drawn character designs against a backdrop of heavily granulated paper. Transition seamlessly into a graphite pencil sketch on textured paper, utilizing cross-hatching, varying line weights, and a 12fps "line boiling" effect to emphasize a hand-drawn feel. Next, morph into a hyper-realistic 3D translucent glass style, characterized by complex light refractions, caustic patterns, and soft internal glows within a minimalist studio setting. Conclude the sequence with a tactile risograph print look, applying a limited three-color palette, grainy halftone textures, and intentional registration overlays for a retro, mechanical finish.

entries.prompt:

MOOD: Quiet late-night self-care diary. Calm, intimate, and unscripted. Feels like a real person documenting a peaceful evening at home rather than creating content for an audience.
