entries.title: 1993 local-TV news field tape: a reporter in front of a burst water main, chroma smear on the beacon, auto-iris pumping, tape tear at the end
entries.description: A 15-second found-footage piece from Seedance 2.5 that nails early-90s broadcast ENG video: a two-person crew covers a burst water main flooding a strip-mall parking lot, the reporter does a stand-up with a hand mic, firefighters stand ankle-deep, and the image ends with the shoulder mount dropping and the picture tearing to blue-black. The prompt is a catalogue of tape faults used as storytelling: interlaced combing on fast movement, chroma smear on the red beacon, clipped highlights, crushed blue shadows, tape noise, head-switching, and a scripted "camera error" where the auto-iris pumps down. It is from a creator thread of found-footage prompts (camcorder home video, broadcast news, product b-roll). Use it for retro news parodies, insurance or utility ads, and period texture tests.
entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-realistic 1993 local-TV ENG news field tape, 16:9: a two-person crew covering a burst water main flooding a strip-mall parking lot at dusk.

SUBJECT: Field reporter, woman, early thirties, no makeup polish, shoulder-length dark blonde hair blown sideways, shoulders squared against the wind. Navy shoulder-padded blazer, cream blouse, dark slacks, black low heels wet to the ankle. Grey-foam-windscreened stick mic at chest height, cable looping out of frame. Composed, brisk, unglamorous. Keep her face, body, hairstyle, clothing and appearance perfectly consistent throughout. Face stable throughout, no deformation.

SETTING: Suburban American strip-mall lot at dusk, 1993. Asphalt split open beside a painted parking line, water pushing up through it and sheeting toward the storefronts, submerged curbs, orange cones, a fire engine and a cruiser throwing rotating red across standing water. Two firefighters in tan turnout gear. Nothing legible anywhere in frame: no chyron, no lower third, no station bug, no timecode digits, no readable signage — the chyron goes on in the edit.

VISUAL STYLE: Raw camera-original field tape, shoulder-mount Betacam SP with a Frezzi on-camera light, 1991–1995, dubbed once to VHS — one generation down. Interlaced combing on fast movement, chroma smear on the red beacon, highlights clipping where the light hits skin, crushed blue shadows, tape noise, head-switching tear along the bottom, auto-iris pumping. 1990s ENG grammar: shoulder-mounted, eye height, single camera, one operator reacting live. No stabilisation, no cinematic moves, no modern grading. Must feel genuinely captured, not AI-generated.

TIMELINE:
00:00–00:04 — WIDE of the lot. Water pushes out of the split asphalt toward the storefronts, beacon red rippling across it; a flattened plastic bag turns in the current. Camera error: the shot opens mid-move, horizon rolled left, corrected in one jerk as the operator settles the mount. Water hissing, wind buffeting the stick mic into a low roar, idling diesel.

00:04–00:08 — CUT TO MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, reporter three-quarters to lens, on-camera light hard on her face, weight shifting foot to foot. Wind lifts her hair across her mouth; she pushes it back with her free hand. Dialogue language: American English, flat working local-news delivery: {uh — main let go about twenty minutes ago} (one-second pause, no speech, she glances down at the water and back to lens) {they've got crews on the valve now}. Camera error: the auto-iris pumps down as the light hits her, face hot and flat half a second before it settles. Handling thump on the mic, wind on the windscreen, radio squelch behind camera.

00:08–00:11 — WHIP PAN. She lifts her free hand toward the lot; the camera whips right to left off her face, overshoots the water column, drags back onto it. Spray throwing sideways, a lot light flickers on. Camera error: overshoot and correction, motion smearing to vertical streaks, focus arriving late. Wind roar spiking through the pan, water rushing louder, a car door.

00:11–00:15 — CUT TO MEDIUM WIDE, two firefighters ankle-deep. One crouched over a valve key with both hands, boot sliding an inch on wet asphalt as he leans; the second steps toward camera, flat palm up, waving the crew back. Camera error: the operator reframes late as he steps, then focus hunts between the palm and the spray. Boots in water, metal ringing on the valve, a shouted word torn away by wind. The mount comes off the shoulder, the frame tilts to wet asphalt, and the image tears and snaps to blue-black like the record button being hit.

AUDIO: Diegetic location sound only, as listed per beat, all of it through a field mic — thin, mid-range, wind-battered, clipping on the loud water. Natural American English speech only. No music, no narration bed, no cinematic sound effects, no artificial sound design, no whooshes on the cuts.

GOAL: A raw field tape off a shelf at a small-market station — mundane, wind-bitten, slightly badly shot, nobody performing. Prioritise real human motion, honest camera mistakes and consistent identity over cinematic beauty.

negative: any legible text — chyron, lower third, station bug, timecode, signage; stabilised cinematic camera moves; duplicated reporter or extra firefighters; face morph or identity drift between beats; warped hands on the microphone; smeared blending across the cuts instead of hard cuts; music; modern digital sharpness; extra limbs; watermarks.

entries.title: Saturated retro-film romance on rusted rail tracks in a wildflower field: fine grain, halation, bloom, slow-motion cross dissolves
entries.description: A 30-second romantic montage made with Seedance 2.5 at 1080p on Higgsfield, defined by its film emulation: a "vivid saturated retro film color grade applied uniformly to the entire frame" (rich reds, deep greens, glowing yellows), fine grain, subtle halation and gentle bloom on an adult couple in their mid-20s on abandoned tracks that dissolve into a field of wildflowers. Beats are linked by named transitions (cross dissolve, one whip pan), and it ends on a bird's-eye rise over the couple lying in blossoms. The phrase "applied uniformly to the entire frame" is a useful trick for keeping a grade consistent across cuts. Good for fragrance, travel or summer-fashion spots.
entries.prompt: Cinematic photorealistic footage, natural daylight, vivid saturated retro film color grade applied uniformly to the entire frame — rich reds, deep greens, glowing yellows — fine film grain, subtle halation, gentle bloom, soft realistic lens texture, dreamy slow-motion feel. No subtitles, no text overlay, no captions. Two Korean lovers — a woman in her mid-20s with long black hair in a flowing pastel yellow summer dress, and a man in his mid-20s with soft wavy black hair in a loose cream shirt and brown trousers — keep the exact same faces, hair, and wardrobe in every shot. Setting: Korean countryside, weathered abandoned railway tracks dissolving into a vast sea of wildflowers, drifting pollen glowing in golden light. Opens on an extreme wide shot: the lovers stand face-to-face on the rusted train tracks at frame center, flower field stretching behind them. Extreme wide shot, slow dolly toward them: clothes and hair move in slow motion, golden light flaring through drifting pollen. Cross dissolve. Close-up, slow push-in: their hands slowly intertwine between their bodies, her soft smile and his gaze blurred in the background, tiny petals floating past. Cross dissolve. Medium close-up, gentle tilt up: the woman tilts her face upward with eyes closed, a slow-motion wave of hair falling across her cheek. Cross dissolve. Wide shot, lateral tracking: the lovers break into a slow-motion run off the tracks into the huge flower field, rails receding behind them, petals kicked up around their legs. Whip-pan transition. Two shot, smooth orbiting camera: in the flower field the couple spins and laughs together, flowers and hair swirling in dreamy slow motion, colors bright and saturated. Cross dissolve. Bird's-eye aerial shot, slow rise: the camera pulls straight up high above the field revealing the couple lying close together in a crown of blossoms. Smooth stable camera work, consistent character identity across every shot. Audio: upbeat instrumental funk groove with slap bass, rhythm guitar, and shimmering synth pads, no vocals; warm breeze and grass rustling underneath, soft dreamy reverb. No text, no labels, no watermarks, no logos, no UI elements. No lens distortion.

entries.title: Underground fashion film in a night parking garage: two women in black leather and streetwear shot through a fisheye, motorcycle inserts
entries.description: A 15-second fashion-film look from Seedance 2.5: two stylish adult women in black leather, sunglasses, chains and contrasting white tops pose and walk through a concrete multilevel parking garage at night, filmed with a heavy fisheye in close and low angles, with inserts of a black motorcycle and a bag being unpacked on the floor. The prompt directs wardrobe and attitude rather than story (textures, accessories, the contrast between the two looks), sets the lens language for the whole piece and bans readable logos. A strong reference for streetwear, eyewear or accessory drops and music-video styling.
entries.prompt: Create a 15 second cinematic underground fashion film in 16:9 inside a real concrete multilevel parking garage at night. Two stylish adult women are the central subjects. One has long straight black hair with blunt bangs, narrow dark futuristic sunglasses, a distressed silver and black sleeveless graphic top, layered metallic necklaces, stacked bracelets, fingerless black gloves, loose dark trousers, chunky black footwear and a large worn black shoulder bag. The second has long pale blonde hair under a fitted black beanie, oversized rectangular black sunglasses, a fitted white top, oversized black jacket slipping casually from her shoulders, a short dark skirt, black thigh high socks, chunky shoes, silver jewelry and a large textured handbag. Use an extremely wide vintage fisheye lens with visible barrel distortion and strong perspective stretching. The camera should feel like a real person holding a small early digital camcorder at arm length. Preserve tiny framing mistakes, slight horizon drift, natural hand vibration, physical footsteps, unpredictable body proximity, realistic autofocus breathing and occasional motion blur. Never make movement perfectly stabilized or mechanically smooth. Open extremely close to both women crouching beside a black motorcycle, staring calmly into the lens while a fluorescent fixture blooms above them. Rapidly orbit and tilt around them as they adjust sunglasses, move their hair and casually interact with the camera. Cut to a dramatic floor level detail of the motorcycle engine, rear wheel, frame, dark metal and chrome reflecting harsh ceiling light. Show both women crouching over an open bag with believable personal objects scattered on the concrete. Insert a brief near black rhythmic cut. Return with an intimate overhead fisheye angle while they search through the bag. The blonde woman raises a tiny silver compact camera toward the lens. One woman stands and crosses the painted white pedestrian stripes while the other collects her bag. Follow them through the garage with loose handheld backward movement. Include concrete pillars, curved driving lanes, yellow curb paint, white directional markings, a black parked car and a white van deep in the background. Around the middle create one very brief three image editorial collage of the dark haired woman from different close perspectives, then immediately return to natural live action. Show her walking away carrying the heavy black bag before both women turn and confidently walk back toward the camera. As they approach, allow the fisheye perspective to enlarge their faces, hands and clothing naturally. Finish by returning to the motorcycle where they crouch close to the camera again, creating a seamless visual loop to the opening shot. Lighting must come almost entirely from practical cold fluorescent garage fixtures with slightly green white color, blown highlights around lamps, deep soft shadows under eyes and clothing, subdued concrete colors and imperfect exposure changes as the camera turns. Image texture should resemble compressed early digital video with mild grain, restrained sharpness, slight chromatic fringing, subtle sensor noise and realistic skin texture. Preserve individual fingers, jewelry, fabric folds, hair strands and physically correct contact with bags, clothing and motorcycle surfaces. Avoid glossy commercial perfection, beauty retouching, floating objects, warped hands, changing clothing, duplicated accessories or impossible architecture. Edit with fast confident cuts synchronized to an original approximately 150 BPM underground electro beat combining distorted kick drum, dry snare, gritty bass, metallic percussion, dark synth pulses and subtle parking garage ambience. Add faint footsteps, clothing movement, bag hardware rattles and motorcycle metal sounds beneath the music. No dialogue. No voiceover. No readable logos or titles.

entries.title: "She promised one outfit": a phone-video yacht comedy that snaps into a fast try-on montage of swimsuit, linen, sundress and strapless looks
entries.description: A 15-second vertical Seedance 2.5 comedy that becomes a wardrobe reel: it opens as a handheld phone video on a yacht deck where Maya (27) protests "You said ONE outfit!", a whip pan lands on Lena (28) at the bow with a suitcase and garment bag ("It is one outfit. For now."), and hard match cuts then run her through a rapid montage of looks (open white linen shirt over a black one-piece, cobalt swimsuit with a sheer sarong, a cream dress, a pink strapless sundress) on deck, stairs and the bow. The prompt is cut-driven: named characters with locks against duplicates ("two Lenas, two Mayas"), each outfit tied to a location and an action, handheld phone texture, no music, and a long negative prompt that bans brand names and changing faces or hair. entries.prompt:
15 second vertical comedy clip, 9:16, photorealistic, shot like a real phone video that turns into a fast fashion montage. Cut driven, handheld, no music.

MAYA. 27, olive skin, long chestnut brown wavy hair with sun lightened strands, dark brown eyes, gold hoops, layered gold necklaces, thin bracelets. Wears a fitted ivory sleeveless square neck top, high waisted colorful print resort trousers, thin tan belt, barefoot. Very expressive face.

LENA. 28, tall, golden skin, long dark espresso brown glossy waves, hazel brown eyes, gold earrings, calm and confident. Same face, same hair, same body, same age in every shot. Only her clothes change.

SETTING: a white motor yacht anchored in a calm turquoise Mediterranean bay. White sailboats in the distance, low rocky green coastline on the same side the whole time, cloudless blue sky, bright late morning sun from the same direction in every shot. White deck, steel railings, cream cushions, coiled ropes. Light sea breeze moves hair and fabric.

STYLE: natural sunlight, real skin texture with pores, correct hands and fingers, real fabric movement, clear turquoise water, no beauty filter, no plastic skin, no heavy HDR.

CAMERA: handheld with small natural shake. Fast whip pans and hard match cuts between outfits. Normal lens, no slow motion, no floating drone moves, no heavy blur.

0.0 to 1.6s Maya stands on the deck, medium close up, sea behind her. She stares off to the right, eyebrows up, mouth open, and leans forward. Maya says, flat and shocked: {No. Absolutely not.} Do not show what she is looking at. <water lapping, hull creak, distant seabirds, wind>

1.6 to 3.0s Camera pushes in. Maya covers her mouth, then drops her hand and points hard to the right. Maya says: {You said ONE outfit!} On the word "outfit" the camera whip pans right along her arm. <bracelets clink, quick footsteps, fast whoosh>

3.0 to 4.6s The pan lands on Lena at the bow, wearing an oversized open white linen shirt over a black one piece swimsuit, black sunglasses, flat sandals, big woven tote. Beside her sit one large suitcase, a garment bag and two tote bags. Medium full shot, railing leading toward her. Lena says calmly: {It is one outfit.} Small pause, she lifts one finger: {For now.} <breeze, rope creak>

4.6 to 6.0s Hard match cut, same body position. Lena now wears a cobalt blue swimsuit with a white sheer sarong tied at her waist, hair damp at the temples, barefoot. She takes two steps toward camera and points at the water. Lena says: {Swim.} <bare feet on deck, water splash, fabric flutter>

6.0 to 7.4s A white towel sweeps past the lens, and behind it Lena now sits at a small deck table with fruit and sparkling water, wearing a coral orange halter dress, sunglasses on her head, woven handbag. She lifts the sunglasses slightly and smiles. Lena says: {Lunch.} <chair scrape, glass on table, soft breeze>

7.4 to 8.8s Hard match cut. Lena stands at the railing in an emerald green satin slip dress with gold statement earrings, same daylight. Wind lifts her hair, she turns her head toward Maya. Lena says: {Sunset.} <wind gust, satin flutter>

8.8 to 10.3s Fast whip pan across the cabin. Lena walks past camera in an ivory cropped blazer, matching wide leg trousers, champagne silk camisole, gold heels, small metallic clutch. Camera tracks back one second. Lena says: {Dinner.} <heels clicking, clutch clasp>

10.3 to 11.8s Hard match cut. Medium close up of Lena in a silver metallic evening mini dress with crystal earrings. She adjusts one earring, completely serious. Lena says: {Emergency.} <soft wind, water>

11.8 to 13.2s Smash cut to a tight close up of Maya, honestly confused, looking toward Lena. Maya asks: {What emergency?} <water lapping, distant boat>

13.2 to 15.0s Cut back to Lena, medium shot, silver dress catching the sun, turquoise water, sailboats and green coast behind her. She slides her sunglasses on, gives a tiny smile to camera. Lena says: {Bad photos.} Maya laughs loudly off screen. Lena walks out of frame. Hard end, no fade. <sunglasses click, real laugh, water, one seabird>

AUDIO: only real sound, meaning ocean, wind, boat movement, footsteps, fabric, bracelets, glass, laughter. Dialogue language: English, natural conversational delivery, never theatrical, never both women talking at once. No music at any point. No narration. No subtitles.

Last frame: empty yacht deck at the bow, turquoise bay, sailboats and green coastline behind, bright sunlight, gentle water movement. No on screen text, no captions, no logo, no watermark.

Negative prompt: music, score, subtitles, on screen text, watermarks, logos, brand names, extra people, two Lenas, two Mayas, changing face, changing hair, changing age, mixed or merged outfits, clothes morphing on the body without a cut, magical transformation, slow motion, drone shots, warped hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, beauty filter, oversaturated colors, moving coastline, changing sun direction, horizontal framing.

entries.title: Monsoon kindness drama in an Indian city: an office worker and an auto-rickshaw driver push a stalled rickshaw through floodwater, played restrained
entries.description: A 30-second documentary-style human drama from Seedance 2.5: on a flooded monsoon evening an office worker with a backpack and umbrella tries to get home, he flags down an experienced auto-rickshaw driver, the rickshaw stalls in a deeper flooded street, and the two push it through the water together until it reaches his apartment entrance and they go their separate ways. The prompt is built for believable acting rather than spectacle: "Human behaviour remains grounded and restrained", per-beat micro-behaviours (heavy breathing after pushing, small posture adjustments while seated), consistent props, and dense rain, headlight and traffic detail. Good for insurance, banking, mobility or community-brand films that need understated performances.
entries.prompt:
30 seconds | 16:9 | live-action human drama
Fictional dramatization. Documentary-style visual realism.

SETTING
A busy Indian city during a heavy monsoon evening.
[flooded roadside / traffic intersection / narrow market street / rain-soaked urban roads / residential street / apartment entrance].
Time: evening.
Heavy rainfall, strong wind, flooded streets, vehicle headlights reflecting across wet asphalt and realistic urban background activity.

CHARACTERS
An office worker returning home and an experienced auto-rickshaw driver.

Maintain consistent clothing, umbrella, backpack, auto-rickshaw and character identities throughout the sequence.
Human behaviour remains grounded and restrained.

STORY

00–05s — ESTABLISHING
Wide observational shot establishing a rain-soaked city during evening rush hour.

Office workers hurry beneath umbrellas while motorcycles, buses, auto-rickshaws and cars slowly navigate flooded roads.

One office worker stands beneath a small roadside shelter unsuccessfully trying to find transportation.

Camera slowly advances from a believable documentary position.

Heavy rain naturally strikes roads, rooftops, vehicles and umbrellas while water flows along the roadside.

05–10s — CONNECTION
Cut to a closer handheld perspective following the office worker stepping into the rain and attempting to hail passing vehicles.

Several occupied auto-rickshaws continue driving past before an older green-and-yellow auto-rickshaw gradually slows and stops.

The driver quietly smiles and gestures for the passenger to get inside.

Camera operator follows behind with natural footsteps, small framing corrections and realistic motion blur.

Rainwater splashes naturally beneath footsteps and passing vehicles.

10–16s — JOURNEY
The auto-rickshaw pulls away into slow-moving traffic.

Heavy rain continues reducing visibility while windshield wipers, headlights and roadside reflections create realistic monsoon conditions.

The driver carefully navigates through flooded intersections as stalled motorcycles, pedestrians beneath shop awnings and traffic congestion remain visible.

Keep geography readable so the journey remains spatially consistent.

Camera reacts naturally to changing road conditions rather than anticipating them.

Avoid exaggerated driving or unrealistic weather effects.

16–21s — BREAKDOWN
The auto-rickshaw enters a deeper flooded street where water reaches the lower body panels.

The engine begins sputtering before suddenly losing power and coming to a stop in the submerged road.

The driver calmly attempts to restart the engine several times while surrounding traffic slowly moves around them.

Camera gradually closes the distance from a believable documentary position as rain continues falling across the stalled vehicle and flooded roadway.

21–26s — SHARED EFFORT
The driver quietly steps into knee-deep floodwater and begins pushing the auto-rickshaw toward the roadside.

Without hesitation, the passenger immediately steps out into the rain and joins the driver.

Together they push the vehicle through the flooded street while passing motorists and pedestrians briefly watch before continuing on.

After reaching shallower water, the driver makes one final attempt to restart the engine.

The engine starts with a rough vibration before settling into a steady idle.

26–30s — AFTERMATH
The auto-rickshaw arrives beside the apartment entrance.

The passenger quietly pays the fare before discreetly leaving extra money in the driver's hand.

The driver notices only after the passenger has already begun walking away through the rain.

He briefly calls out but the passenger simply raises one hand without turning back.

The driver smiles quietly, places the money safely inside the dashboard compartment and drives back into the rain as another waiting passenger raises a hand beside the roadside.

End on quiet humanity rather than sentimentality.

CAMERA
Grounded observational-documentary cinematography.

Mix:
wide environmental coverage
medium handheld following shots
brief close reaction shots

Natural handheld instability.
Realistic operator movement.
Plausible camera positions.
No impossible drone transitions.
No excessive slow motion.

LIGHTING
Lighting originates from the actual environment.

Natural exposure changes when moving between streetlights, shop lighting, apartment lighting, vehicle headlights and darker flooded roads.
Realistic highlight roll-off.
Deep but detailed shadows.
No artificial rim lighting around characters.

PHYSICS
Real gravity and momentum.

Feet maintain contact with flooded terrain.
The auto-rickshaw responds naturally to potholes, standing water and uneven road surfaces.
Rainwater splashes realistically beneath moving feet and tires.
Clothing responds naturally to wind and rainfall.
Water flows naturally through drains and across road surfaces.
Characters physically interact with the vehicle, seats, handles, doors and surrounding environment.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE
Restrained, believable behaviour under difficult weather conditions.

Heavy breathing after running through rain and pushing the vehicle.
Quick visual checks of surrounding traffic.
Small posture adjustments while seated and while pushing.
Natural hesitation, patience, kindness and quiet gratitude.
No exaggerated emotional reactions.

AUDIO
Heavy rainfall.
Vehicle engines.
Auto-rickshaw engine vibration.
Repeated engine restart attempts.
Water splashing beneath tires and footsteps.
Windshield wipers.
Passing horns.
Traffic ambience.
Distant thunder.
Quiet conversation between driver and passenger.
Engine finally restarting.
Rain gradually softening during the final moments.

No oversized Hollywood trailer effects.

VISUAL CHARACTER
Photorealistic live-action footage.
Observational documentary character.
Natural skin texture.
Realistic wet fabric and material response.
Subtle sensor noise.
Natural motion blur.
Imperfect handheld framing.

Avoid:
video-game aesthetics
CGI appearance
excessive HDR
oversaturated colors
impossible flooding
floating water
perfectly choreographed movement
beauty-filter faces

CONTINUITY
Maintain consistent character identity, clothing, umbrella, backpack, auto-rickshaw, flooded streets, rainfall intensity and lighting throughout the sequence.

Preserve geographic orientation and screen direction.

Every action begins from the physical state established by the previous shot, creating one continuous uninterrupted 30-second narrative from the office worker searching for transport to the quiet act of generosity before both characters continue their separate journeys.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-photorealistic cinematic slice-of-life film that is visually indistinguishable from real footage. Every frame should resemble a premium Netflix lifestyle documentary or luxury commercial, captured on a professional full-frame cinema camera using 50mm and 85mm prime lenses in true 8K HDR. Use physically accurate lighting, natural dynamic range, realistic optical lens characteristics, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, authentic motion blur, lifelike skin with visible pores, realistic eye reflections, accurate fabric simulation, and natural environmental details. Avoid any CGI or AI-generated appearance.

The film follows a 30-year-old European woman living a peaceful countryside life. She has naturally tied brown hair with loose flyaway strands, minimal makeup, expressive eyes, realistic skin texture, and wears comfortable linen clothing in warm neutral tones. Every movement should feel subconscious and naturally observed—never posed or performed. She never looks directly into the camera, and her expressions remain subtle and genuine.

The story begins inside a cozy farmhouse at sunrise as warm morning light fills the bedroom. She wakes naturally, opens the wooden window, and breathes in the fresh countryside air while looking across mist-covered fields. She then prepares fresh bread in a rustic kitchen, kneading dough by hand, placing it into a traditional oven, and cleaning the wooden countertop with calm, deliberate movements.

Next, she walks into her small garden, gently watering herbs, collecting ripe tomatoes, and brushing her fingers across fresh plants while sunlight creates soft natural lens flares. The journey continues with a relaxed walk through a charming European village lined with stone cottages, flower-filled windows, bicycles, and narrow streets before she visits a small local market to purchase fresh flowers and seasonal fruit. Include natural blinking, relaxed breathing, realistic eye movement, subtle posture adjustments, correct body weight shifts, accurate finger anatomy, believable hand interaction with objects, natural walking speed, realistic hair movement, and true-to-life fabric physics. Nothing should resemble acting or posing.

Audio Design (Critical): No dialogue, no narration, no subtitles, and absolutely no background music. Tell the story entirely through immersive environmental ASMR. Synchronize every sound naturally with the visuals, including birds singing, gentle wind, wooden floor creaks, curtain movement, dough kneading, ceramic bowls, oven door, running water, leaves rustling, footsteps on grass and stone paths, distant village ambience, market sounds, paper bags, coffee pouring, spoon stirring, page turns, doors opening, evening insects, and quiet countryside room tone.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic fixed CCTV security-camera recording inside an ordinary apartment building hallway at night.

The entire video must be ONE CONTINUOUS STATIC SHOT from a ceiling-mounted security camera.

The camera NEVER moves.
No cuts.
No camera shake.
No zoom.
No change of perspective.

The hallway is completely ordinary: beige walls, apartment doors, tiled floor, fluorescent ceiling lights.

A single adult man wearing ordinary casual clothes walks slowly through the hallway.

His shadow is clearly visible on the floor.

IMPORTANT: Keep the man's body, clothing, face, shadow, hallway geometry, lighting and camera position CONSISTENT throughout the entire video.

TIMELINE:

0–10 seconds:
The hallway is empty.

The man enters the frame and casually walks down the hallway.

Everything looks completely normal.

10–15 seconds:
The man stops underneath one of the ceiling lights.

He stands still for a moment.

His shadow is directly beneath and behind him, behaving normally.

15–19 seconds:
The man begins walking forward again.

His body moves normally.

BUT HIS SHADOW DOES NOT MOVE.

The man's shadow remains exactly where it was when he stopped.

The man continues walking several steps away from it.

The shadow stays completely stationary on the floor.

19–23 seconds:
The man suddenly notices something is wrong.

He stops walking.

He slowly turns his head and looks back toward his shadow.

The shadow remains in the exact location where he originally stopped.

23–27 seconds:
The man remains completely still.

His shadow slowly turns its head toward him.

IMPORTANT:
Only the SHADOW moves.
The man's actual body does NOT move.

The shadow's movement must be subtle, slow and physically impossible.

27–30 seconds:
The man takes one small step backward.

The shadow takes one small step FORWARD toward him.

The man freezes.

Abruptly CUT TO BLACK.

REALISM IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN DRAMA.

The footage must initially look like completely authentic boring apartment CCTV.

Use realistic low-quality surveillance footage:
16:9 aspect ratio, fixed wide-angle security camera, mild compression, low-light digital noise, subtle fluorescent lighting, realistic shadows and ordinary colors.

DO NOT use:
glowing shadows,
black smoke,
ghost effects,
distorted humans,
monsters,
floating objects,
melting,
morphing,
extra people,
changing architecture,
camera movement,
cinematic lighting,
dramatic effects,
or exaggerated horror imagery.

The supernatural effect must come ONLY from the shadow behaving independently of the person.

entries.prompt:
CAMERA:

Handheld camcorder aesthetic, landscape framing. A beautiful French ceramic artist films herself by hand, selfie-cam and first-person, on a rainy night in her home studio.

Keep real hand shake, crooked framing, autofocus hunting between her face and the spinning wheel, awkward zoom-ins, and framing mistakes where her face or the wheel slips out of frame.

Never show her placing or setting up a camera; enter fixed angles with a clean jump cut as if the camera was already positioned. The camera itself never appears, not even in the dark window reflection.

LOOK:

Warm desk lamp over the wheel, rain streaking down a dark window, tea steaming on the shelf. Camcorder softness, faint shadow noise.

Clay realism is the core: wet slip glistening as the wheel turns, clay deforming exactly where her fingers press, honest muddy hands. Real skin texture, calm late-night glow.

STYLE:

A realistic rainy-night throw-a-bowl-with-me studio vlog, ASMR-adjacent: calm, warm, quietly focused, talking to the lens in a low voice like a friend sitting beside her. Clearly attractive, but believable as self-recorded, not an art commercial. Clean jump cuts, real sounds: wheel hum, wet clay, rain on glass.

CHARACTER:

A beautiful French woman around 30: soft grey-blue eyes, dark blonde hair twisted up in a claw clip with loose strands, minimal makeup. Cream linen shirt, sleeves rolled past the elbows, clay-stained canvas apron, no jewelry, bare hands for the wheel.

SETTING:

A small home pottery studio at night: a potter's wheel under a warm lamp, water bucket, sponge, wire tool, a wooden shelf of finished mugs and bowls, a rain-streaked dark window. Lived-in and quiet. No other people, no pets.

CONTINUITY RULES:

The same woman fully consistent in every shot: no face, hair, outfit or body changes.

The clay moves in one direction only: wedged lump, centered, opened, walls pulled tall, shaped into a bowl, wired off the wheel. Never collapses backward, never regenerates, never changes size.

Hands are the top priority: five fingers always, clay deforming only where her fingers press, slip and water obeying real physics. The wheel always spins the same direction; props keep their positions.

No extra people, not even in the window reflection. No duplicated limbs. Keep her beautiful, calm and photogenic in every shot.

STORYBOARD:

30 seconds, 10 cuts.

1. (3s, selfie) She sits by the wheel, rain behind her, sips tea, smiles softly at the lens. Dialogue: "It's raining. Studio night. Come sit."
2. (3s, handheld pan) The camera drifts across the tools; she slaps a wedged lump of clay onto the wheel head. Dialogue: "One bowl. That's the plan."
3. (3s, fixed) Jump cut: already centering, elbows braced, clay running smooth between her palms. No dialogue, just wheel hum and rain.
4. (3s, first-person) Her thumbs open the center and the walls begin to rise. Dialogue: "This part. Breathe with it."
5. (3s, same shot) One steady pull, the wall rises taller, slip streaming down her fingers. No dialogue.
6. (3s, selfie) She lifts both muddy hands beside her face, laughing quietly. Dialogue: "I touched my face earlier. Don't zoom in."
7. (3s, tight handheld) The sponge smooths the rim; a small wobble evens into a clean curve. Dialogue: "Almost. Almost."
8. (3s, fixed) The wheel slows to a stop; she draws the wire under the bowl in one clean pass. Dialogue: "Off. Clean. Thank you."
9. (3s, close-up) The finished bowl at rest; she presses one fingerprint into the wet foot like a signature. Dialogue: "Signed."
10. (3s, selfie ending) The bowl on the shelf beside the mugs; she dims the lamp, rain still falling. Dialogue: "One bowl. Worth it. Good night."

A spontaneous nostalgic winter memory filmed on an old consumer MiniDV camcorder. Handheld POV operated casually by a friend/family member, with occasional imperfect framing, hand shake, delayed autofocus, exposure pumping, awkward zooms, slight motion blur, tape grain and soft DV image quality. 0–5s: She sits lazily on her bed scrolling on her phone. Notices snow outside, pauses and says softly, “Wait... is it actually snowing?”

5–10s: She rushes to the window and opens the curtain. Snow is falling outside. Exposure shifts naturally. She smiles in disbelief as autofocus briefly switches between her face and snowy background.

21–26s: She stops on the snowy sidewalk, looks upward and catches snowflakes in her palm. Her breath is subtly visible and snow moves naturally around her.

26–30s: Close handheld shot. Snow lands on her hair and coat. One flake hits the camera lens, creating a soft blur. She turns toward the camera and smiles warmly, saying, “I haven't seen the first snow in so long.” Camera remains shaky as snowfall continues.

AUDIO: Only natural room tone, phone handling, curtain, footsteps, coat fabric, door, wind, traffic, city ambience and intimate camcorder-recorded dialogue. No music.

entries.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 30fps premium compact-camera concept ad as one continuous visual narrative around a single unbranded portable camera. Product design: horizontally elongated rounded rectangle, about 2.1:1; large circular lens on the left, about 68% of body height; narrow pure-black display area on the right; silver sandblasted matte-aluminum frame; black micro-textured body; flush circular top shutter; tiny dark-red front status dot; precise continuous edge seam. Lens: six dark-gray aperture blades, brushed-black ring, and layered dark optical glass with subtle blue-gray/cool-white reflections only—no rainbow flare. Show no brand, logo, text, numbers, or settings. Keep this exact design: never turn it into a phone, DSLR, or action camera; add no lenses, buttons, screens, grips, or flash.

Style: premium industrial-design advertising and precision electronics photography; restrained framing, generous negative space, and fast, exact camera moves. Light with a large rectangular soft source upper-left, a thin rim upper-right/rear, and a controlled vertical soft reflection on the lens. Backgrounds shift between black, cool gray, and warm white. Four consistent minimalist art stills: an ivory feather floating on deep graphite gray; black volcanic rock on warm-white seamless; curved silver sheet as minimal sculpture; circular ripples on cool-gray water. Palette: black, white, silver-gray, with only a hint of blue-gray in water. No people, landscapes, flowers, pets, or cluttered desks.

Timeline:
0–1.7s — Extreme macro inside the lens. Six aperture blades rotate outward together; the opening grows from a tiny cool-white point to about 30% of frame height. Pull back rapidly along the optical axis, revealing credible internal lens depth and mechanics.
1.7–3.5s — Continue pulling back while arcing about 25° right. A thin edge light sweeps across and reveals the full body at about 55% frame width.
3.5–5.3s — Rush into the lens center and transition to a warm-white studio. The viewfinder contains only the floating ivory feather between deep gray and warm white, plus four corner marks, a hollow central focus box, thin horizontal line, and small red dot—no text/settings. The box contracts to lock focus as the camera arcs about 12° around the feather for parallax.
5.3–7s — Fire the shutter without a white flash. Aperture closes about 40% inward, briefly dimming exposure. The viewfinder becomes a refined image card with a thin warm-white border; three matching cards fan out behind it, showing rock, metal, and water. All cards have identical size and spacing and float in warm white.
7–9.2s — Cards form a horizontal sequence. Travel quickly left-to-right at low height; nearby edges gain directional blur while distant cards create parallax. Pass feather, rock, and metal, then brake before the water card with a 5% overshoot and settle.
9.2–11.4s — Water card enlarges about 8% and ripples. Accelerate into it until water fills the screen; skim about 3 cm above the cool-gray surface as circular ripples expand and the central highlight gradually assumes the lens shape.
11.4–13.2s — Approach the dark circular reflection at the center. As it fills frame, shape-match cut to the product’s front lens glass. Pull out and arc about 30° up-left to reveal the full camera while the background becomes seamless warm white.
13.2–15s — Product floats at a three-quarter front-left angle. Arc about 20° upward and push in about 12%, decelerating with a slight overshoot and settle. A cool-white highlight crosses the frame and lens ring; the red dot lights once. Hold the final 0.6s perfectly still, product about 48% frame width in generous warm-white negative space; no title or fade to black.
Use shape/position matches among lens, cards, ripples, and product lens. No harsh cuts, flashes, liquid morphs, or impossible deformation. Sound: restrained, precise modern experimental electronics—blade friction, mechanical lock, low air-suck on pullback, focus ping, clean shutter click, paper-like card unfolding, stereo card-pass whoosh, low water immersion, ripple resonance, and subdued final product thump. No narration, vocals, orchestral music, or heavy EDM drums.
Avoid cheap plastic or toy-camera styling, rough chamfers, mirror-like metal, rainbow flare, blue-purple tech glow, neon, and cyberpunk. Avoid thick Polaroid borders, random card rotation, intersections, duplicated images, distortion, or disappearing elements.

entries.prompt:
15 -Second 3D Ice Cream Advertisement — Dark Luxury Style

Create a 10-second ultra-cinematic 3D ice cream advertisement with a dark, luxurious visual identity. The ice cream must look irresistibly creamy, rich and highly detailed, with dramatic product lighting and realistic physical textures.

0–2 SEC — THE MYSTERY

Start in near darkness.

A single ice cream scoop slowly emerges from black shadow, suspended above a glossy dark surface.

Tiny frozen particles float through the air.

A narrow beam of dramatic light reveals the creamy texture and delicate melting edges.

2–5 SEC — THE REVEAL

The camera rapidly circles around the ice cream.

Reveal a luxurious dark chocolate ice cream scoop surrounded by floating chocolate fragments, cocoa dust and tiny ice crystals.

The ice cream slowly rotates while glossy chocolate sauce flows naturally across its surface.

Use high-end 3D food simulation with realistic melting, gravity and liquid behavior.

5–7 SEC — THE SENSORY MOMENT

A spoon enters the frame in slow motion and gently cuts through the ice cream.

Show the inside texture in extreme macro detail:

soft cream → chocolate layers → tiny chocolate pieces → glossy sauce.

A small amount of melted ice cream stretches naturally from the spoon.

Camera follows the spoon with a smooth cinematic movement.

7–9 SEC — HERO SHOT

Chocolate shards rise dramatically around it and freeze in mid-air.

A subtle mist rolls across the surface.

9–10 SEC — FINAL BRAND MOMENT

Camera slowly pushes toward the ice cream.

A final dramatic light sweep travels across the dessert.

Leave a clean dark area for a brand logo or tagline to be added later.

End with a deep cinematic bass hit and a subtle crystalline sound.

VISUAL STYLE

Photorealistic 3D CGI, luxury food commercial, dark cinematic palette, deep blacks, rich chocolate tones, dramatic studio lighting, volumetric atmosphere, macro photography, realistic ice cream physics, realistic melting, detailed chocolate textures, glossy reflections, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, premium advertising quality, smooth camera motion, sophisticated composition.

IMPORTANT

The ice cream must remain the hero subject throughout the entire 10 seconds.

Use completely original product presentation and generic unbranded packaging.

entries.prompt:
A fifteen second photoreal macro sequence in liquid glass one instant of time held perfectly still while the camera keeps moving through it.

SUBJECT: A suspended mass of clear liquid glass caught mid-splash a rising column, its crown petals flaring outward, trailing ribbons and airborne droplets held exactly where they are. Surfaces are smooth and rounded, edges lensing sharply, the interior threaded with fine bubble trails and faint internal striations. Nothing sags, nothing drips, nothing falls. The glass stays completely static for the entire clip.

SETTING: A black seamless void. One wide soft key from high camera-left, one cool crisp rim from behind and slightly below. Polished black floor holding a shallow inverted reflection of the frozen mass. No horizon, no walls, no props, no figures.

STYLE: Photoreal high end commercial gloss. Anamorphic macro glass, shallow depth of field, rich refraction and caustics cast across the floor, specular highlights that crawl only because the camera moves. Colorless glass with faint cyan and warm amber dispersion at the thinnest edges. Fine 35mm grain, gentle chromatic aberration, deep blacks, no motion blur on the glass.

CAMERA: One continuous take, no cuts. The camera is the only thing in the frame that moves. Every object remains absolutely still.

0-4s   Extreme macro on one suspended droplet floating in black space, a bright caustic star glowing inside it. The camera drifts slowly right and racks focus through the droplet to the ribbons behind it. <a low sub-bass hum, almost below hearing>
4-8s   The camera pulls back and cranes slightly up. The droplet joins a constellation of suspended glass fragments, all motionless, refracting the key light in slow crawling arcs as the lens travels. <a faint high crystalline resonance, like a soft rim tone>
8-12s  Full reveal the camera orbits left around the whole frozen splash column, crown petals flared wide, caustics sweeping across the polished floor with the move. The mass never shifts position or shape. <quiet air tone, a single soft glass tick>
12-15s The orbit decelerates and settles into a locked wide, the column centered, rim light sharpening one edge to white. Everything holds. <the hum thins out into near silence>

AUDIO: Diegetic only. Sub bass room tone, faint crystalline resonance, one soft glass tick, quiet studio air. No background music. No score. No voice. No subtitles.

Last frame: The frozen liquid glass column centered in a wide, crown petals flared, rim light on one bright edge, caustics pooled still on the polished black floor, camera at rest. No on-screen text, no captions, no titles, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.

entries.title: Hands-only chilli-garlic noodle recipe reel: hard cuts, tiny top-of-frame ingredient labels with amounts, live blue flame and a warm off-screen narrator
entries.description: A 30-second Seedance 2.5 (1080p, via the Pika API, prompt written with Codex) social recipe reel that looks edited: one cook's hands chop garlic and red chilli on an end-grain board, bloom chilli flakes in oil, toss noodles in a black pan over a ring of live blue flame and finish with a plated bowl and spring onions, with a warm, bubbly off-screen narration. The prompt is written like a production document ([Generation Goal], [Global Setting], timed shots) and controls on-screen graphics precisely: "Tiny white ingredient labels appear only at the very top of frame", each with exact wording ("garlic" above "4 cloves"), plus a scored audio fade that resolves before 30 s. A reusable format for food brands, recipe apps and cookware ads.
entries.prompt:
[Generation Goal]
Generate a brisk hands-only recipe reel in which one cook prepares chilli-garlic noodles from raw ingredients to a finished bowl, with a warm bubbly off-screen narration, clearly readable cooking geography, and a complete final reveal.
[Global Setting]
The same compact food set persists throughout: a dark end-grain wood board beside a lit gas stove, one black pan resting on the cast-iron trivet, and a ring of live blue flame visibly licking around the pan base in every shot where food is cooking. Soft directional key from front-left; the background falls to near-black while red chilli, glossy crimson oil, green spring onion, and warm cream ceramic remain richly saturated and colour-accurate. Tight food photography with slight macro compression, realistic steam, oil viscosity, knife weight, and ingredient contact. Camera is mechanically locked in every shot with no handheld movement, alternating only between a true overhead and a low near-frontal macro where the knife works toward the lens. Hands only, never a face; the cook's torso remains a soft dark block behind the work. Every cut is hard and clean. Tiny white ingredient labels appear only at the very top of frame: bold lowercase ingredient name over a smaller italic quantity, correctly spelled and held long enough to read.

[Stage 1 — 0.0–7.5 seconds]
Initial state: the empty dark board fills the overhead frame; the recurring hands wait just outside frame. At the first frame, a bundle of noodles drops onto the board with a soft thud and settles completely. The exact top label reads “noodles” above “200 g”. Hard cut to the identical set from the low near-frontal macro: a chef's knife rocks through garlic, the blade travelling toward the lens, then the palm flattens the cloves; the exact top label reads “garlic” above “4 cloves”. Hard cut overhead as finely sliced red chilli is gathered into a neat pile, then cut low near-frontal as the knife completes the last slices; the exact top label reads “red chilli” above “1”. Hard cut overhead as the blade scrapes the chilli cleanly into a small bowl and the bowl is placed beside the garlic. End state: noodles, prepared garlic, and prepared chilli are visibly separated and ready beside the still-empty pan; all knife motion has finished. Off-screen voice, close and friendly: {Okay — chilli garlic noodles, and this takes about eight minutes. Garlic thin, chilli fine, everything ready before the pan gets hot.}
[Stage 2 — 7.5–15.0 seconds]
Continue from the prepared ingredients and the same set. This is the fastest passage, alternating overhead and low near-frontal hard cuts, but every physical action reaches a readable end state. The black pan is already seated on the cast-iron trivet with the burner on; the circular live blue flame remains clearly visible around the base in every shot. Overhead: oil shimmers in the pan. Low near-frontal macro: garlic drops into the hot oil and erupts into a sharp sizzle, then visibly begins turning pale gold. Overhead: chilli flakes fall in; the exact top label reads “chilli flakes” above “1 tsp”, and the oil blooms crimson. Low near-frontal: a metal spoon drags once through the mixture, scraping the pan and knocking the rim. Overhead: the spoon completes one clean circle and stops, leaving a glossy red aromatic oil with the garlic still golden, not burnt. End state: aromatics are evenly dispersed in glossy red oil, spoon at rest, flame still alive and visible. Off-screen voice: {Garlic into hot oil — don't walk away, it goes from golden to gone in about four seconds.}

[Stage 3 — 15.0–22.5 seconds]
At 15.0 seconds, a full-frame flat process card replaces the live image: warm cream field, bold condensed dark type reading exactly “3 MIN”, and one small simple chilli icon. Hold it just long enough to read, then hard cut back overhead. The same black pan remains on the lit trivet with blue flame visible around its base. Noodles now enter the pan; two hands lift and fold them through the red oil with metal tongs. Hard cut low near-frontal on the same continuous tossing action; the tongs finish the fold and release the noodles back into the pan. Hard cut overhead as one spoonful of noodle water enters and the sauce visibly turns silkier and clings to the strands. End state: noodles are evenly coated, contained inside the pan, tongs held above them, blue flame still visible. Off-screen voice: {Then everything in together — and keep it moving so nothing catches. A spoon of noodle water makes the sauce cling.}
[Stage 4 — 22.5–30.0 seconds]
Continue from the coated noodles. Low near-frontal macro: soy pours in one thin dark stream; the exact top label reads “soy sauce” above “2 tbsp”, the stream stops cleanly, and the live blue flame remains visible below the pan. Hard cut overhead as the tongs complete two broad folds and place the finished noodles into the warm cream bowl; cooking is now finished, so the bowl sits on the dark board away from the burner. Sesame and sliced spring onion fall across the surface in one restrained garnish beat. Hold a slow true-overhead reveal: chopsticks lift one glossy strand high out of frame in one continuous normal-speed motion, steam crossing the front-left key, then the strand settles into a stable suspended line. Hard cut to the only gently advancing shot, a very small mechanically smooth low-frontal push toward the finished bowl; no handheld motion. The push finishes by 28.7 seconds and the camera becomes still. End state: the complete bowl fills the lower frame, garnish intact, steam easing, chopsticks still, no unfinished action. Off-screen voice: {And that's it. Go on — you've got eight minutes.}

[Maintain Consistency]
Keep exactly one pair of hands, the same sleeves, board, pan, trivet, burner, cream bowl, chopsticks, knife, spoon, and tongs throughout. The pan never cooks on a bare countertop. In every cooking shot, the black pan is physically seated on the lit gas stove and the cast-iron trivet plus ring of live blue flame are clearly visible. Keep labels at the top only and spell every requested line exactly. Preserve normal-speed physics; calm at the end comes from the action genuinely finishing, not from slow motion. No faces, no subtitles, no extra hands, no brand logos, no morphs, no wipes, no dissolves.
[Audio]
A newly composed light, bouncy instrumental bed begins under the opening action: muted marimba taps, soft pizzicato strings, gentle brushed percussion, and a warm round bass pulse, with no familiar melody, no singing, no lyrics, and no vocalising. It ducks clearly under every spoken line and rises only in the short silent action gaps. Foley is large, close, and synchronized in beat order: noodles thud on wood, knife rocks and cloves flatten, blade scrapes chilli into ceramic, burner hiss, violent garlic sizzle, chilli flakes patter, spoon scrape and rim knock, tongs clack, wet noodle fold, soy stream, sesame scatter, chopsticks touch ceramic, and quiet steam-room ambience. The off-screen narrator is a bright, bubbly adult woman speaking natural conversational English exactly as written, never on camera. Her final word “minutes” lands by about 27.8 seconds. The score answers with one warm two-note cadence, resolves by about 28.8 seconds, then the last note and room tone decay toward near-silence through 29.7 seconds while the completed bowl holds. No abrupt audio cut at 30.0 seconds.

entries.prompt:
Create a 12-cut motion-graphics spot in 16:9, 24fps, exactly 15s. Theme: Chinese tea ceremony, modern oriental design.
This film is 80% bold graphic design in motion and 20% object action.
Palette: ink black, rice-paper white, vermilion red, muted gold. Style: modern Chinese minimalism — ink-wash textures meet flat geometric shapes; red seal stamps are the transition device.
CUT 01 | 0.0-1.2s - White void. A single giant Chinese character 「茶」 brush-strokes itself into existence, ink bleeding at the edges.
CUT 02 | 1.2-2.4s - Hard cut: a vermilion circle expands from center; the character punches through it in white.
CUT 03 | 2.4-3.6s - Top-down teacup on black; steam rises and morphs into flowing ink ribbons.
CUT 04 | 3.6-5.0s - Ink ribbons snap into a horizontal row of geometric tea leaves sliding left on beat.
CUT 05 | 5.0-6.2s - Giant 「静」 in muted gold on black; snap zoom onto the final brush stroke.
CUT 06 | 6.2-7.6s - Teapot silhouette pours; the pour-line becomes a vermilion diagonal splitting the frame.
CUT 07 | 7.6-9.0s - Split frame: ink mountains left, flat vermilion right; a white teacup slides along the divide.
CUT 08 | 9.0-10.4s - A red seal stamp SLAMS down with frame shake, revealing 「回甘」 in white inside the seal.
CUT 09 | 10.4-11.8s - Rapid-fire alternation: three tea leaves, three geometric shapes, on beat.
CUT 10 | 11.8-13.0s - All elements collapse into one spinning ink circle.
CUT 11 | 13.0-14.0s - The circle resolves into the teacup; one drop falls; slow-motion ripple.
CUT 12 | 14.0-15.0s - End card: 「茶」 large, small English "TEA — est. in stillness" below, red seal bottom-right, hold.
Typography rule: every character is fully readable for at least 12 frames before anything overlaps it. Use as few Chinese characters as possible, large size only.
Editing: hard cuts on beat, graphic matches, snap zooms, ink-splash wipes.
Audio: guzheng pluck + modern percussion; SFX locked to cuts (brush swoosh, seal slam, water drop).
DO NOT: extra glyphs, misspelled or deformed hanzi, rainbow gradients, 3D bevel text, photoreal footage, added characters.

entries.prompt:
TERRA CACAO — Craft Chocolate
Tagline: Every bar is an expedition.
Mascot: Nib, a tiny cacao-bean explorer in a folded leaf hat
Palette: cocoa brown #5C3A21, caramel gold #D98E32, cream #F6EED9
Reveal mechanic: the canyon is the bar's cross-section; the SNAP is the punchline
Prompt
A 15-second cinematic storybook advertisement in three beats.

STYLE: soft 3D storybook realism, hand-painted textures, warm golden light, visible brush grain, shallow depth of field, rich cocoa-and-caramel palette with cream highlights, subtle film grain, cozy miniature atmosphere, no outlines, no anime features.

CHARACTER: Nib, a tiny round cacao-bean explorer with a glossy brown body, big amber eyes, and a folded leaf hat. Nib must look identical in every shot.

BEAT 1 (0-4s): Aerial glide over a majestic canyon river of flowing golden caramel at dawn, cliffs of dark chocolate, boulders of whole almonds, cacao pods hanging like lanterns. Nib rows a walnut-shell boat down the river. Sound: gentle river lap, distant birds, a soft adventurous flute.

BEAT 2 (4-10s): Close-ups: caramel swirls around the boat, Nib trails a hand in the glossy river, ducks under a dripping caramel arch, grins. Camera orbits the canyon in warm light. Sound: a happy hum from Nib, dripping caramel, rising strings.

BEAT 3 (10-15s): The camera rises fast — the canyon walls straighten into geometric edges: this is the cross-section of a giant chocolate bar. A hand enters and snaps the bar in half. Hard cut to the snapped bar beside its cream wrapper reading "TERRA CACAO," Nib printed on the wrapper mid-row. A warm male voice whispers: "Every bar is an expedition." Sound: everything cuts to silence, then the loud SNAP of chocolate, then one warm piano note.

RULES: no text or branding until the final two seconds, the world stays fully dimensional until the rise, seamless single take until the snap.

entries.title: Hand-drawn 2D anime cooking: beef rendang with cassava leaves in 20 fast cel-shaded shots, hands only, warm Indonesian home kitchen
entries.description: A 15-second Seedance 2.5 anime food sequence with 20 multishot cuts (about 0.75 s each) from text only: onions and chillies sliced on a wooden board, spice paste frying in an iron wok, coconut milk poured over beef, the sauce darkening to glossy reddish brown, cassava leaves boiled and strained, rice plated and the rendang spooned over. The visual-style block defines the look precisely ("Completely hand-drawn appearance, clean full-color cel shading, delicate pencil-like linework, subtle hand-drawn imperfections", analog film grain, faint cel colour bleeding) and the rules keep it to hands, cookware and food (no faces, eating or reactions). entries.prompt:
15-second video, 20 multishot scenes, approximately 0.75 seconds per shot, generation from text only, no reference images, no storyboard images.

【Visual Style】
Original Japanese hand-drawn 2D anime cooking footage. Completely hand-drawn appearance, clean full-color cel shading, delicate pencil-like linework, subtle hand-drawn imperfections, warm natural colors, soft atmospheric kitchen background, analog film grain, faint cel color bleeding, expressive food animation.

Warm Indonesian home-kitchen atmosphere. Worn wooden counter, traditional cooking utensils, black iron wok, wooden cutting board, ceramic bowls, stainless-steel pot, rice cooker or heavy pot. Warm daylight from a nearby window with soft shadows.

Food is the visual focus. Rendang sauce should gradually become deep reddish-brown, glossy, thick, and richly textured. The boiled cassava leaves should remain naturally deep green and visibly tender.

【Theme and Rules】
Theme: Indonesian beef rendang served with steamed white rice and boiled cassava leaves (daun singkong rebus).

Show only hands, forearms, ingredients, cookware, steam, oil, sauce, rice, and textures.
No faces, heads, full bodies, eating, tasting, or character reactions.

The sequence must clearly show the cooking process from raw ingredients to final plating. Each shot has one clear primary action. Use rapid but readable cinematic cuts.

Recipe progression:
Prepare beef → slice aromatics → sauté spice paste → add beef → add coconut milk → simmer → reduce → stir until rendang becomes thick and dark → cook rice → boil cassava leaves → drain → fluff rice → plate → add rendang → add cassava leaves → final beauty shot.

【20 Multishot Breakdown】

Shot 1 — 0.00–0.75
High overhead close shot of raw beef chunks on a worn wooden cutting board. A hand uses a heavy knife to cut the beef into medium-sized rendang pieces. One clean decisive cut.

Shot 2 — 0.75–1.50
Macro close-up of shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal, red chilies, lemongrass, and turmeric being sliced rapidly on the board. Knife strokes are fluid and precise.

Shot 3 — 1.50–2.25
45-degree close shot. Ground spice paste is scraped from the cutting board into a black iron wok containing a small amount of hot oil. The paste hits the oil and immediately sizzles.

Shot 4 — 2.25–3.00
Macro shot of the spice paste being stirred with a wooden spatula. Oil glistens around the paste. Tiny bubbles form while steam rises naturally.

Shot 5 — 3.00–3.75
Medium overhead shot. Beef pieces are added into the aromatic spice mixture. A wooden spatula pushes and folds the beef through the paste until every piece is coated.

Shot 6 — 3.75–4.50
Close-up. Thick coconut milk pours into the wok in a smooth white stream, spreading around the red-brown beef and spices.

Shot 7 — 4.50–5.25
Low side shot at wok level. Lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and whole spices are added. The liquid begins to simmer, producing small slow bubbles.

Shot 8 — 5.25–6.00
Macro shot of the rendang simmering. Coconut milk visibly reduces. Bubbles become slower and heavier while oil begins separating from the sauce.

Shot 9 — 6.00–6.75 ★Texture Showcase
Extreme macro. Wooden spatula slowly drags through the thickening rendang. The sauce folds over itself and leaves a temporary trail. Beef surfaces become increasingly dark and glossy.

Shot 10 — 6.75–7.50
45-degree medium shot. The hand repeatedly turns the beef with a wooden spatula as the sauce clings tightly to every piece. Steam rises in soft curls.

Shot 11 — 7.50–8.25
Cut to a stainless-steel pot. High overhead view of fresh cassava leaves being placed into rapidly boiling water. Steam bursts upward.

Shot 12 — 8.25–9.00
Macro close-up of cassava leaves boiling. Leaves move naturally beneath the water, changing from fresh bright green to a deeper cooked green. Small bubbles surround the leaves.

Shot 13 — 9.00–9.75
Medium overhead shot. A metal strainer lifts the cooked cassava leaves from the pot. Water streams through the leaves in thin realistic trails.

Shot 14 — 9.75–10.50
Close-up of cooked white rice. A wooden rice paddle gently breaks apart and fluffs the rice. Individual grains separate softly, with delicate steam rising.

Shot 15 — 10.50–11.25
Macro shot of the finished rendang. The sauce has become thick, dark reddish-brown, oily, glossy, and heavily clinging to the beef. Spatula gives one final slow fold.

Shot 16 — 11.25–12.00
High overhead shot of a plain ceramic plate. A wooden rice paddle places a compact mound of fluffy white rice in the center.

Shot 17 — 12.00–12.75
45-degree close shot. Several pieces of dark glossy rendang are placed beside the rice. Thick sauce stretches briefly from the spatula before falling onto the plate.

Shot 18 — 12.75–13.50
Close overhead shot. Boiled cassava leaves are arranged neatly beside the rice and rendang. The leaves appear tender, moist, and deep green.

Shot 19 — 13.50–14.25 ★Final Texture Showcase
Macro close-up across the plated food. Camera slowly glides from fluffy rice to glossy rendang and then to the textured cassava leaves. Steam rises from the rice and rendang. Strong highlights move across the thick sauce.

Shot 20 — 14.25–15.00 ★Completion Shot
Elegant overhead three-quarter angle. Complete plate of white steamed rice, dark glossy beef rendang, and boiled cassava leaves. Hold briefly and quietly. The food remains the only focus. Warm daylight, subtle steam, rich hand-drawn cel shading, appetizing final frame.

【Camera】
Use rapid cinematic cuts between high overhead, 45-degree diagonal, medium side, low wok-level, close-up, and macro shots. Never repeat the exact same camera setup in consecutive shots.

Camera remains stable within each shot. Only subtle slow push-ins, tiny pans, or natural settling are allowed. No handheld shake, whip pans, rotations, or chaotic movement.

Shots 9, 15, and 19 should receive the strongest macro texture emphasis.

【Textures and Motion】

• Raw beef: moist, fibrous, natural meat texture.
• Spice paste: thick, slightly oily, granular and aromatic.
• Hot oil: small fast bubbles and realistic ripples.
• Coconut milk: smooth, creamy, flowing naturally.
• Rendang reduction: progressively thicker, darker, oilier, and more glossy.
• Final rendang: thick sauce firmly clinging to irregular beef surfaces.
• Rice: individual soft grains, fluffy and slightly glossy, subtle steam.
• Cassava leaves: tender, wrinkled, moist, naturally deep green.
• Boiling water: vigorous bubbles and realistic steam.
• All liquids obey realistic gravity and viscosity.

【Physical Continuity】
Maintain consistent beef pieces, cookware, hand proportions, utensils, and ingredient appearance throughout the sequence.

Rendang must visibly progress from light coconut-based liquid → reddish-brown simmering sauce → thick dark reddish-brown rendang.

Do not magically jump from raw ingredients to finished rendang.

The cassava leaves must visibly transition from fresh leaves → boiling → softened cooked leaves.

The rice must appear cooked and fluffy only during the rice preparation and plating shots.

【Lighting and Set】
Warm Indonesian home kitchen. Worn wooden counter, black iron wok, stainless-steel pot, wooden spatula, knife, cutting board, ceramic plate, metal strainer, simple bowls.

Warm daylight is the key light. Soft cool bounce on the shadow side. Clear but gentle ground shadows. Rendang sauce should provide the strongest glossy highlights, while the white rice provides visual contrast and the green cassava leaves provide the strongest natural green accent.

Background remains simple and subordinate to the food.

entries.prompt: An elderly night janitor cleans an abandoned Art Deco planetarium during a thunderstorm. The projected moon becomes physically real and drags the entire auditorium into its gravity. entries.prompt: Create a 30-second title sequence governed by one strict continuity rule: every shot must inherit one visual object, shape, texture, or typographic element from the previous shot, and that inherited element must transform into the central subject of the next composition. Begin with a perfectly transparent glass sphere floating in a dark studio environment. The camera slowly approaches it. A reflection inside the sphere gradually resembles the letter O. Transition seamlessly so the sphere itself becomes a typographic O in the word “ORIGIN.” The O should then expand until its interior becomes a circular tunnel. Move the camera through that tunnel. At the far end, reveal that the circular opening is actually the iris of a human eye. Move closer until the iris texture fills the frame. Allow the radial iris pattern to transform into an abstract sunburst graphic used behind the next title card. Continue this inheritance logic throughout the entire sequence. Each transformation should feel surprising in hindsight but visually inevitable once it occurs. Avoid unrelated cuts, arbitrary imagery, or transitions based solely on dissolves. Every new scene must be born from something physically or graphically present in the preceding scene. Introduce five to seven distinct title cards across the sequence. Keep typography elegant and readable. Maintain a consistent visual identity even as environments change. Use controlled camera movement, cinematic macro photography, precise lighting, tactile materials, and sophisticated match transitions. For the final transformation, bring several earlier visual motifs back together without repeating them literally. The last inherited form should resolve into the title “CONTINUUM.” Hold the final title in a calm, minimal composition. The sequence should demonstrate long-range visual continuity, transformation logic, object permanence, and design memory rather than simply producing a chain of beautiful independent shots.

entries.prompt:
Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic time-journey as ONE completely seamless, continuous, unbroken camera shot. No cuts, fades, dissolves, montage, teleportation, or resets.

A woman enters an ordinary old house and moves continuously through it while the same rooms transform through centuries.
Begin at dusk.
A modest old house stands alone in a quiet field.
The woman enters through the front door.
The camera follows directly behind her into a simple kitchen.
As she passes through a doorway, the room transforms seamlessly into a Victorian interior: dark wood, brass, gaslight and period furniture.
She continues through the hallway.
The walls and staircase transform around her as she climbs.
The Victorian house becomes a medieval stone hall with tapestries, candles and rough wooden furniture.
She opens another door.
The camera follows.
The interior becomes an ancient stone dwelling surrounded by an ancient city visible through the windows.
She keeps moving.
The architecture rapidly evolves around her as she passes through connected rooms: ancient stone becomes medieval timber, timber becomes industrial brick and iron, industrial becomes twentieth-century modern, then contemporary glass and concrete.
The woman changes naturally with each era: clothing, hairstyle, accessories and posture adapting while she remains the same continuous person.
She reaches the final door.
She opens it.
The camera follows her into the future.
The house has become an extraordinary futuristic residence integrated into a vast green city. Glass walls reveal vertical gardens, elevated transit and luminous architecture.
She walks into one final room.
It is completely empty except for a simple wooden chair.
The camera slowly moves backward through the doorway.
As it retreats, the futuristic room remains behind her while earlier versions of the house appear through successive doorways: modern, industrial, medieval, ancient.
The camera reaches the original entrance.
For the first time, we see the entire house from outside.
It is no longer old.
It is enormous and ancient-looking, surrounded by a completely transformed future landscape.
The woman is still visible through the distant window.
The house has remained through every age.
End on the quiet realization that while civilizations changed completely, this one place remembered them all.
Photorealistic cinematic realism, emotional, mysterious, elegant, awe-inspiring, family-friendly. The transformations must occur physically during camera movement, never as abrupt scene changes. Keep the woman continuously moving until the final moment.

entries.prompt:
A 15-second single continuous take in 9:16 vertical at 30fps: a photoreal 3D automotive render with the energy of a video game's garage customisation reel.

Image 1 is the car. Recreate the exact supercar from the object sheet: gunmetal grey paint that flips to mauve-rose in the light, carbon aero and trim, white turbine wheels with black centres, red calipers, slim white LED headlight strips, a full-width red taillight bar, a rear wing, red bucket seats and a small gold M emblem. Keep its proportions and identity locked in every frame.

Image 2 is only a layout guide for the room's geometry. The car sits on a circular turntable in the centre of the garage, ringed with a glowing cyan light. The far wall has a wide metal shutter with a bright white LED ceiling light box above it. Behind the camera is a glass entry ramp. Along the left wall are a tool pegboard with a holographic screen and a robotic arm on a floor rail. Tall black cabinets fill the far corners, a wheel rack stands in the near right corner, and white EV charger pods and a glowing glass panel sit on the right wall. Every wall, the floor and the ceiling are clean blank surfaces, with plain polished concrete underfoot and zero lettering, signage or overlays anywhere in the room.

The look is a clean, clinical, high-tech garage. Cool white light falls from overhead and the turntable ring and wall panels add cyan accents. The polished grey concrete floor has glossy wet reflections and a faint haze drifts across it. Long white light streaks slide over the car's paint. The image is crisp and high contrast, with a cool palette in which the car's red and gold are the only warm colours.

The camera is a handheld-feel FPV with wide fisheye barrel distortion. It uses aggressive whip pans, crash zooms and fast orbits, with heavy motion blur on every move. Speed ramps slow down on each upgrade and snap fast between them. Every transition is a camera move inside one unbroken take.

The shot opens on a locked wide hero frame from the glass entry ramp, looking toward the shutter. The car faces camera on the slowly rotating turntable, its cyan ring glowing and the ceiling light box blazing behind it. The camera whips in with a crash zoom down onto the hood, wobbling through the fisheye, as the robotic arm swings in from the left wall. The hood transforms in beats: grey paint, then raw exposed carbon weave, then a vented carbon hood with a thin mauve centre stripe, with small sparks on each swap. The camera dives in a fast orbit to the front wheel, with the wheel rack visible behind it. The rims swap on the beat, going from white turbine to gloss black mesh to satin gold forged 6-spoke with a polished lip, and the red calipers glow brighter. A low tracking slide along the side skirt follows as a livery wipes across the doors: angular mauve and deep red pencil-stroke graphics, pure shapes only. The camera swings to the rear three-quarter view. The red taillight bar flares, and the rear wing rises higher on carbon swan-neck struts and locks with a hydraulic hiss. The camera swoops over the roof and whips down past the gold wheel in a motion-blur smear. It then pulls back and settles into the same wide hero frame as the opening. The underglow ignites and cycles from cyan to red to white, the headlight strips flash on, and the turntable completes its turn as the car holds, fully built and gleaming.

Audio: a hard-hitting phonk drift beat at around 140 BPM, with a cowbell melody and distorted 808s. Every upgrade lands on a downbeat with a bass impact. Layer in pneumatic hisses, robotic arm servo whirrs, ratchet clicks, carbon panel clunks and a turntable motor hum, and end on an engine rev blip as the underglow fires.

entries.prompt:
A single continuous vertical 9:16 shot, 15 seconds, photorealistic, shot like a viral smartphone/drone-style action video in bright desert sunlight. A motocross rider in a white full-face helmet, a neon-yellow riding jersey and pants, white riding boots and gloves, on a blue dirt bike, rides straight up a gigantic, almost vertical red-orange sandstone wall. A huge crowd stands along the rim at the very top, hundreds of people with phones raised, cheering. Clear deep-blue sky, harsh midday sun, strong warm red and orange tones.

Action, in sequence:
0–1s: Close behind-the-rider view. He sits on the bike at the base of the cliff, back to camera, revving, bright yellow jersey against the red rock. Another rider on a blue bike waits in the far left background.
1–2.5s: He launches forward and hits the base of the wall. The rear wheel spins hard and throws a thick, billowing cloud of orange dust. The camera pulls back as he goes up the rock.
2.5–5s: He rides straight up the wall, getting smaller as he climbs. A long fiery-orange dust trail streams down behind him along the rock face. The top rim comes into view with a thin line of spectators looking down.
5–10s: The camera tilts up and tracks him from below as he climbs, bike nearly vertical, back to camera, arms slightly out, wheel kicking up bursts of orange dirt that tumble down the rock. The crowd along the top edge grows bigger and clearer as he gets closer.
10–12.5s: The rim fills the top of the frame. Hundreds of spectators lean over the edge with phones held up, shouting and waving. The rider keeps steady throttle, closing the last few meters, dust still streaming below him.
12.5–15s: He reaches the top. The front wheel crests the edge, the crowd surges forward and grabs him and the bike, pulling them over the edge into the crowd, a mass of hands, phones and raised arms around him.

Camera: Starts at close shoulder height behind the rider, then pulls back and tilts up with fast, slightly shaky handheld energy, following him up the cliff from below at a steep low angle. Ends at a low-angle shot of the crowd swallowing him at the rim against the blue sky. Wide-angle phone lens, sharp focus on the rider, natural motion blur on the dust.

Lighting and look: Strong direct sunlight, saturated orange-red rock, deep blue sky, high contrast, neon-yellow jersey popping against the red wall, glowing backlit dust clouds, crisp texture on the rock face and bike.

Audio: A high-revving two-stroke or four-stroke dirt bike engine, tire spin and rocks skittering down, the crowd's roar growing louder toward the top, ending in screams and cheers as he is pulled over. No music.

Avoid: cuts, text overlays, logos or readable brand names, cartoon style, distorted bike or body, extra riders in the main action, watermark.
